Friend, we'll be honest: [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5 [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Hi friend, it's Wendy Davis. I'm going to ask you to support my good friend Colin Allred's campaign to defeat Ted Cruz. But first, let me tell you why Colin is the steady leader we need in the Senate:
I first met Colin when he worked as the DFW Regional Voter Protection Director for my campaign in 2014.
Here's the thing about Colin: What you see is what you get – Colin is a community servant before all else. I knew from the day I hired him ( almost 10 years ago! ) that he would do everything in his power to make sure Texans have every opportunity to succeed.
That's why I was so proud to endorse him in 2018 when he decided to run for Congress and defied all odds to defeat a 22-year Republican incumbent.
And it's why I'm thrilled to support Colin again now. He can defeat Ted Cruz if we give him the resources he needs to reach voters across Texas. That's why I'm personally asking you to support him, too. Please, will you split a donation of $5, or any amount, between Colin and Kirsten Gillibrand to help Colin send Ted Cruz packing once and for all? [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
DONATE → [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
I'm sure I don't need to convince you how terrible Ted Cruz has been for Texans.His attacks on our reproductive freedom and LGBTQ+ rights, his outrageous book ban, his irresponsible trip to Cancun while a winter storm caused power outages across the state ... I could go on and on, but the long and short of it is this: We need a new senator, and Colin Allred is the real deal.
Experts agree Texas is winnable. FiveThirtyEight called it Democrats' best pickup opportunity in 2024, and CNN says Cruz is the most vulnerable Republican senator on the ballot. All we need is a powerful, Texas-sized grassroots movement made up of passionate supporters like you, friend.
So please, will you join me by splitting a donation of any amount between Colin's campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand today? Colin needs to raise $45,000 by midnight, and I promised we'd help him get there. Every dollar gets us that much closer to defeating Ted Cruz → [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
DONATE → [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
I promise you won't regret this,
Wendy Davis

subject: Why I’m standing with Dr. Brian Williams
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Brian Williams for Congress
body:
| | Peter,

On February 14, 2018, my daughter Jaime was murdered in her own high school in Parkland, Florida. Her life was senselessly taken by a mass shooter who never should have had access to a gun in the first place.

Jaime's death left me devastated and enraged. Knowing that I will never make new memories with my daughter — never watch her graduate, never hear her voice as she tells me about her day again, never see her grow into the confident and intelligent woman I knew she was going to be — **broke me.**

I knew I had to do something to ensure no other family had to endure the devastating pain my family went through. **That's why, in the memory of my daughter, I've dedicated my life to stopping gun violence and supporting candidates who WILL fight for the lives of our communities.**

**It's how I maintain hope for a better tomorrow and why I’m supporting Dr. Brian Williams in his run for Congress.[Will you join me by contributing to his campaign now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74190276/440873734/1642379951?refcode=em23_231128_FRFR_fnd_gq_act___FRDBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231128_FRFR_fnd_gq_act___FRDBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=5820b3fa-4f8e-ee11-8924-6045bdd47111&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTgyMGIzZmEtNGY4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjQtNjA0NWJkZDQ3MTExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UqBobfHRafmQw7A-XzpovOGHigOe4l3NeslV4Kfgj80=)**

As an Air Force Officer, Brian trained with weapons of war, and he knows they have no place in our communities. As a trauma surgeon, he's seen what these guns do to bodies, and he's running for Congress because the crisis is only getting worse.

The terrible reality is that gun violence has become the norm in America today. Working in the trauma bay, Brian treated the _never-ending_ flow of gun violence victims, and he has had to tell far too many parents that their children had died from gun violence. Every year, there are hundreds of mass shootings, and thousands die due to gun violence. **But it doesn't have to be this way.**

The current gun violence epidemic is a direct result of decades of inaction from gun extremist lawmakers who put guns over the lives of people, including my daughter. Now more than ever, we need leaders who are ready to deal with the reality of gun violence — leaders like Dr. Brian Williams.

Real change is possible when we have leaders in office with the frontline experience and are bold enough to take courageous action. I really do remain hopeful that the days of the gun violence crisis are numbered because of the great people I have had the good fortune of meeting — and Brian is one of them.

[**Dr. Brian Williams is ready to go to Washington to end the gun violence crisis that has ripped families like my own apart. Will you make a donation to his campaign? Chip in $5, or any amount, today to help elect Dr. Brian Williams for TX-32. clean_body: | | Peter, On February 14, 2018, my daughter Jaime was murdered in her own high school in Parkland, Florida. Her life was senselessly taken by a mass shooter who never should have had access to a gun in the first place. Jaime's death left me devastated and enraged. Knowing that I will never make new memories with my daughter — never watch her graduate, never hear her voice as she tells me about her day again, never see her grow into the confident and intelligent woman I knew she was going to be — broke me. I knew I had to do something to ensure no other family had to endure the devastating pain my family went through. That's why, in the memory of my daughter, I've dedicated my life to stopping gun violence and supporting candidates who WILL fight for the lives of our communities. It's how I maintain hope for a better tomorrow and why I’m supporting Dr. Brian Williams in his run for Congress.= As an Air Force Officer, Brian trained with weapons of war, and he knows they have no place in our communities. As a trauma surgeon, he's seen what these guns do to bodies, and he's running for Congress because the crisis is only getting worse. The terrible reality is that gun violence has become the norm in America today. Working in the trauma bay, Brian treated the never-ending flow of gun violence victims, and he has had to tell far too many parents that their children had died from gun violence. Every year, there are hundreds of mass shootings, and thousands die due to gun violence. But it doesn't have to be this way. The current gun violence epidemic is a direct result of decades of inaction from gun extremist lawmakers who put guns over the lives of people, including my daughter. Now more than ever, we need leaders who are ready to deal with the reality of gun violence — leaders like Dr. Brian Williams. Real change is possible when we have leaders in office with the frontline experience and are bold enough to take courageous action. I really do remain hopeful that the days of the gun violence crisis are numbered because of the great people I have had the good fortune of meeting — and Brian is one of them. = If you've saved your Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

You probably think of California as safely blue, but...
Earlier this fall, a celebrity Republican named Steve Garvey entered our U.S. Senate race.
Because of California’s “jungle primary” system, the top two vote getters in March’s primary **(regardless of party)** will move onto the general election in November. **And a recent poll shows Garvey within reach of a top two finish.**

subject: [LAST CHANCE] Help unlock $100,000 for climate campaigns before MIDNIGHT
body:
__(Remember: If you start a monthly donation - even if it 's just $5 - we get to count it 12 times!) |
---

| With just a few hours left of Giving Tuesday, it looks like you haven't yet renewed your LCV membership to help LCV unlock an additional $100,000 matching gift. Is that right, Peter?

[Will you take a moment to review the information below and then make your gift to help us reach our 1,000 donor goal before midnight? (Remember: If you start a monthly donation -- even if it's just $5 -- we get to count it 12 times!)](https://links.messages.lcv.) |

* * *

---

|
Peter -- earlier this month, we got the incredible news that a major donor put up a $100,000 challenge grant to fund LCV's pro-environment campaigns into the new year.

The catch is that this grant ONLY unlocks if 1,000 LCV members make a contribution before midnight on Giving Tuesday -- **that 's tonight, just a few hours away. And right now, we're not on track to meet this goal.**

[We really can't afford to come up short on this one. Please, please, please renew your LCV membership and help unlock an additional $100,000 to fund our critical campaigns >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

_REMEMBER: If you start a monthly donation -- even if it's just $5 -- we get to count it 12 times!_

| | **
** **FOR IMMEDIATE REVIEW**

**Supporter Record:** Peter Willis
**Email:** dpwillis67@gmail.com

**GOAL:** 1,000 donations by midnight tonight
**PROGRESS:** 86% to goal

**STATUS:** [Renew now -- it only takes $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.) |
---|---|---

Peter, we honestly can't afford to leave this kind of money on the table -- not when our movement is up against so much, and the stakes are so high for people and our planet. Here's a little more info why hitting this goal matters SO much:
1. **Because Republicans are _still_ threatening to shut down our government unless they get massive cuts to environmental programs.** We just narrowly avoided a government shutdown, but the next funding deadline is right around the corner, and every environmental legislative attack the MAGA fringe has passed in recent weeks is still on the table: We _have_ to make sure all of our progress doesn't end up on the chopping block now. [We're counting on your support to defend the environment in Congress. Pitch in now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
2. **Because we can get closer to our goal of protecting 30 percent of U.S. lands and waters by 2030 with more monument designations.** President Biden has already taken action to protect cultural and sacred sites for Indigenous people and landscapes rich in ecological and historical value in Nevada and Arizona, accessible plateaus and ridges in Texas, landmarks honoring the fight for racial justice and snow-capped peaks in Colorado, among others. Now there are even more opportunities to protect more lands and culturally significant sites for people rather than for logging and fossil fuel industries -- and we need people like you on our side. [We can win these fights, but only if the environmental movement shows up >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
3. **Because we have the chance to shut down the Dakota Access Oil Pipeline once and for all.** For years, the Standing Rock Sioux Tribe has led the fight against the dirty Pipeline, which threatens clean drinking water for millions of people. Now, the Army Corps of Engineers has been ordered by the courts to conduct a new environmental impact analysis and take public comment as a result of the Tribe's steadfast opposition. [This is our best-ever opportunity to shut down this project -- and your support can help make that happen. Donate today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
4. **Because a group of donors has offered $100,000 in matching gift funds.** Bottom line: Your contribution goes further to win environmental campaigns that matter if you give now and help unlock this critical funding. [Renew your LCV membership for $5 today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

**Peter -- if we can get 1,000 donations before midnight tonight and unlock the $100,000 challenge grant, it'll be a gamechanger for each and every one of these campaigns.**

[The ONLY way we'll get there is with your help -- I really hope you'll renew your membership today. Remember: Even gifts of $5 count!](https://links.messages.lcv.)

Thank you for your support of LCV's work!

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters
__
__

---

I hope you’ll hear me out for a few minutes — I promise this story ties back to the work we’re doing together. Growing up, I witnessed the value of hard work firsthand. My parents, who both worked tirelessly to support our family, ingrained this value in me from a young age. From my dad's career as a union lineman to my mom's work as a seamstress and automobile tire factory worker, I learned that perseverance and going all in for what you believe in can make a lasting difference. This mindset fueled my pursuit of a mechanical engineering degree in college, where I had the opportunity to help build — and race! — a carbon fiber solar-powered car called the "Sun Tiger." That was only the start of my passion for clean energy. From there, I held a number of jobs, from working at the Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque to a nonprofit organization focused on helping children engage with the great outdoors, and helping raise Albuquerque’s minimum wage and crafting green building codes on the City Council. Peter,
**Before we ask you to help us defeat Josh Hawley and elect Lucas Kunce to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, here’s a look at our race by the numbers:**

**Hawley won this Senate seat with only 51% of the vote in 2018 — and in our last Senate race during a presidential election, the margin was only 2.7%.** So now, with multiple polls confirming that this will be a neck-and-neck race, it’s clear we really can defeat Hawley and flip this seat next year.

Together, we’ve accomplished a lot this year.
✔ We passed the comprehensive **Climate Resiliency Package** , which provides $90 million in funding for more than a dozen climate bills, and unlocks $1 billion or more in federal funding created by the Inflation Reduction Act.
✔ We protected children from toxic chemicals by updating the **Toxic Free Kids Act** ; and better protected all Oregonians from toxic chemicals in personal care products by passing the **Toxic Free Cosmetics Act**.
✔ We addressed waste by passing a **Polystyrene Foam Ban** , which will protect Oregonians from cancer-causing PFAS or “forever chemicals,” and **Legalizing Reusables** , which allows people to use their own containers for take-out and grocery bulk bins.
✔ We stopped every Major Threat bill that was introduced, preventing rollbacks to climate protections and threats to our land use system.
✔ We rallied thousands of Oregonians to support a **climate-smart Farm Bill** and protect Oregon’s majestic **Owyhee Canyonlands**.
We should all be proud of what we’ve accomplished together this year, but we’ve still got a lot of work cut out for us in 2024. There are important bills to pass during the short legislative session, and a critical election that will decide the future of our state.

body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4591%2E5257348%2EsXpHxK)
Derek, I wanted to make sure you saw this urgent message from Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman.
His twin brother Eugene Vindman, the former ethics officer on the White House’s National Security Council who helped uncover Trump’s impeachable offenses in the impeachment effort I helped lead, just announced his campaign for Congress in Virginia.
**[Split a contribution of any amount between Eugene Vindman’s campaign for the House in Virginia and my campaign for the U.S. Senate in California, and let’s elect this champion for our democracy to join me in Congress.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em_vindman.t5vKbb&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20231128_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4591%2E5257348%2EsXpHxK)**
Thanks,
Adam
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: LTC (Ret.) Alexander Vindman
Date: November 16, 2023
Subject: Humbly asking for your help
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em_vindman.t5vKbb&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20231128_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4591%2E5257348%2EsXpHxK)
It’s Alexander Vindman.
Most of you know that I’m an Army Veteran. And most of you know who I am because of Trump’s first impeachment trial.
But it wasn't just me who blew the whistle on President Trump. It was me and my brother Eugene — a former Colonel in the U.S. Army — who was the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House at the time.
Today, Eugene is running for Congress in Virginia where he will continue the fight to defend our democracy and the Constitution both of us swore to protect.
But he can't do it alone.
I am with him – there is nothing more important to me right now. So if you believe Congress needs more members with the integrity and courage to put service to country first, I am asking:
**[Can I count on you to use this link to contribute to split a donation between my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia and Adam Schiff’s campaign for Senate in California? They need all of us to stand with them, like they have stood strong when taking on Trump.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em_vindman.t5vKbb&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20231128_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=4591%2E5257348%2EsXpHxK)**
When I testified before Congress during the first impeachment of Donald Trump, I did it to stand up for our democracy.
My brother and I were both attacked by Trump. Both of our careers in the Army suffered and ended before their time.
Since both of us stood up to Trump, Republicans’ abuse of power and attacks on our democracy have only grown.
Most recently, extremists in Congress chose Mike Johnson to be Speaker of the House – the “mastermind” of the attempt to overturn the 2020 election and undermine our democracy.
We need more members in the House who are willing to stand up to extremism and who are prepared to hold corrupt officials accountable.
We need members with the courage to put their constituents first.
My brother Eugene has defended this nation throughout his career, he stood up to Trump, and he will do that in Congress. Adam Schiff does that. But they can't do it without your help:
**[Can you please use this link to contribute directly to my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia and Adam Schiff’s campaign for Senate in California? Eugene and Adam have stood with us and for the Constitution, now they need our help.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em_vindman.t5vKbb&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20231128_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=4591%2E5257348%2EsXpHxK)**
Eugene’s congressional campaign is extremely important to me. Thank you in advance for donating to Eugene and Adam’s campaign today. This means a lot to me personally.
Alexander Vindman
[DONATE NOW](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em_vindman.t5vKbb&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC30_20231128_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=8&akid=4591%2E5257348%2EsXpHxK)

| It's no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms stack up so you can decide on the fit for you.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6nfueg12brdqo2ga49ffsbflf2mo7f4kf09ith8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9im9oj1cph2bs)
### Overview of Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab
Vanguard made a name for itself by creating and offering low-fee investment products such as mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). It still does this, and even non-Vanguard clients can buy Vanguard funds via a brokerage account. The firm has grown to now offer non-proprietary investment products and funds.

Fidelity is perhaps best known for its personal investment products, namely brokerage accounts that allow users to trade stocks. Clients can invest in a wide range of stocks, bonds and other investment products using a Fidelity brokerage account. Fidelity also makes an effort to provide investment resources to its clients and doesn't usually charge fees on all trades, though more and more brokerages and broker-dealers are moving toward fee-free investment models.

Schwab has a number of passively and actively managed funds that you can invest your money into. You also have the option to trade individual equities. It also offers free robo-advisor services, and those who want to work with a real advisor will have that option as well. [Learn how the fees compare here.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmflh30mtne045t2fs98bq8qtj5hdifq6ndpa52o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9im9oj1cph2bs)

### How to Speak With a Financial Advisor

If you're interested in getting financial advice, consulting a fiduciary financial advisor can be a great first step. That's why SmartAsset created a [free tool](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4nm4rqduk78bv65pjpoq25aae1n3luke50pl6mo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9im9oj1cph2bs) to help match you with up to three financial advisors who serve your area. All advisors on the matching platform have been rigorously vetted through a proprietary due diligence process.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor feel more at ease about their finances and could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1 It's never too late to work towards a more comfortable retirement.

subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpvmlmubbt9hm7g1ik85t2bods0sd3k7ji45nv6o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9im9oj5clh2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdr84f10s23jv4gi3k5v95ls6v5q47o2dk12vo08_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9im9oj5clh2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu97533ahenr4ahenn8gj4s1i5jljiccfggp6da0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9im9oj5clh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znio12p666b4rlaf0gokbtlff0lolrif16lhvb58_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9im9oj5clh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

subject: A Personal Plea: Help Me Protect the American Dream
body:
American Cornerstone Institute

|
---
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c685079%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7M4Zs1FINxOUv%2bwMn0CDHg&sysid=1)
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Today, our nation stands at a crucial juncture. The foundational principles that have shaped this great country, the cornerstones of faith, liberty, community, and life, are being threatened. The very essence of our American Dream is under siege. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c685070%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=x94cR0Vy232InMiy3MeNhQ&sysid=1) As the founder of the American Cornerstone Institute, I have written a petition calling for us to collectively uphold these cardinal values in the face of rapidly shifting ideologies. It is a patriotic call to arms to those who believe in preserving our traditional American principles.

Your [signature on this petition](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c685071%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=giRVJgPL%2fx38RsWUTSYLWg&sysid=1) is not just a mark on a document - it's a personal statement of belief, a voice affirming the importance of faith, liberty, family, and life in the fabric of our society.

The stakes have never been higher. I urge you to [stand with me now](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c685072%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=HH1%2fAflGbnc3sE2uY9DJFQ&sysid=1) to ensure that our nation remains a beacon of hope, freedom, and opportunity for future generations.

Your commitment and dedication to these values are invaluable. Together, we can make a difference.

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36270%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SQqJ%2fQxWagrD2vHpdxDd%2fQ&sysid=1)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36271%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wF3LNDrtf9MwNUKnIk1s5g&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

Did you get a chance to read our previous email?

Governor Inslee recently led a delegation of 25 officials and business leaders to Australia and Tasmania for climate change discussions. Despite the obvious emission-saving potential for conducting such meetings virtually, the trip cost taxpayers tens of thousands of dollars and left a massive carbon footprint.

The irony is glaring, with the delegation emitting a minimum of 112.5 metric tons of CO2, equivalent to a person being a vegetarian for 210 years or carpooling exclusively for 110 years to offset.

This, however, isn't the first instance of Inslee's hypocrisy, as his environmental record is marked by skyrocketing carbon emissions and failed green policies burdening working families. Now, as his term concludes, Inslee is dipping into state resources to leverage his "green" image for a post-governorship paycheck.

While mainstream media avoids criticism, we here at Shift WA will expose Inslee's hypocrisy. _**[But we need your support right now.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62518942:WjHIlmiN4:m:1:2610672541:F0CCD85626915D7A017CDCC21C3DDDF1:r)**_

Washington")
---
|
Friends,

Earlier this month, Governor Jay Inslee took an international trip to Australia and Tasmania. Inslee led a delegation of 25 government officials and business leaders on this pricey trip. Their mission? Discussing climate change initiatives.

Yes, you read that right, because climate change issues, evidently, cannot be discussed over a Zoom call.

Evidently, for our dear governor and his entourage, attention-getting climate change discussions required spending tens of thousands of taxpayers dollars and--oh, the irony--leaving behind an enormous carbon footprint. According to Free Flight USA, one round-trip alone from Seattle to Sydney spews out 4.5 metric tons of CO2. Multiply that by 25, and congratulations, Inslee's posse gifted the atmosphere with a minimum of 112.5 metric tons of CO2. All so they can talk about how much they care about climate change.

To offset that colossal carbon footprint, one would have to be a vegetarian for 210 years or carpool exclusively for 110 years. But who needs facts when you've got virtue signaling, right?

Of course, this isn't Inslee's first tango with hypocrisy. Our green governor has a penchant for globe-trotting, all generously funded by us, the taxpayers. Maybe he's just racking up frequent flyer miles for the planet. Who knows?

But let's get real. The data shows that Gov. Inslee's environmental record is disastrous. Carbon emissions in our state have skyrocketed under his watch. His extreme green policies? Utter failures, unless you count the unsustainable tax burden they've slapped on working families.

Adding insult to injury, now that Inslee's time as governor is coming to an end, he is using his faux "green" image as a golden ticket for his next gig. And that's all while dipping into state resources for his little job tour.

### Overview of Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab
Vanguard made a name for itself by creating and offering low-fee investment products such as mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). It still does this, and even non-Vanguard clients can buy Vanguard funds via a brokerage account. The firm has grown to now offer non-proprietary investment products and funds.

Fidelity is perhaps best known for its personal investment products, namely brokerage accounts that allow users to trade stocks. Clients can invest in a wide range of stocks, bonds and other investment products using a Fidelity brokerage account. Fidelity also makes an effort to provide investment resources to its clients and doesn't usually charge fees on all trades, though more and more brokerages and broker-dealers are moving toward fee-free investment models.

Schwab has a number of passively and actively managed funds that you can invest your money into. You also have the option to trade individual equities. It also offers free robo-advisor services, and those who want to work with a real advisor will have that option as well. ## Hunter Biden, House Committee in Standoff
Hunter Biden has agreed to testify before the House Oversight Committee that's investigating Biden family finances, but he insisted that [his testimony be given in public](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAQQH-N3RF5BmNC4eKadLn2SouPwZ4TAQtIov33q2y95dNrnt6_-3a3nDjvf-2D1h7LZn3nF20AAo1Auc1jWCMRkhxpBT0BLsus9XisXoGmqO0V4BpURCdhQu_QSqknUPPIK04oAdDApIyCizLRqSCVDrSQdmaYJwrcS738L5z7QTF9lRfViy-PMa1H72cb5J8BbwPe7Jnp3T7qA7WzTzTg7XjmTlU4DpSFL3mv1JqodD5dYm9zE5xf1DrvtnPJoj3dWShboVS8LiYEbw1qMwORdLAo4yggwuzHuobzzSlxW_QwT_vDcvop67-P-g4AAP__VWpqOw), despite the committee's demand that the session be closed. Committee Chairman James Comer said Biden could testify again publicly in the future, but the committee [expected him to sit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAURL_G7m5kwMahcLFNurftlhGGcbgrDFnAid7fr5z6dSMdjc5o_nzdvyxHTo_fdsfStny3rvELdyFIGpLqPvZ-2QAJ1WMR8yCk1uM892HB1ehpgxsgvTcGK6RTYr3iqrWTm-t5kYNUQkgjhslM4jKZbZ28mmYPjXk13TjAc8vl8jdzagFb_M4vlIvLex-X0NqzdupXJ2-dvLWAwDGerJO3kHckvOsnHhWdvI1KDXqYKRypodDKHokK_h2ordLzWCM7CrCF04O2knf6NOk0Vn6ERm9QsC9QBRJ954NO7GKu8ORzLlRRK-dUqWXabeLnEW073X1Z_PPNMXLVczcOj93yZ2rffn71fwAAAP__h-Z9sQ) for a closed-door deposition on Dec. 13 as outlined in the original subpoena. The high-stakes face-off is part of an aggressive new legal strategy Biden is pursuing. [Democrats are divided](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LtuhDAQheGnMR3IM8YYChdp3G3alMiXASby4hU4i_bto02d7hRH-qT_6zbfPGfe109_J1uXMvtY-UkzQItTi2rum2QXIiTVkAUjAYehN6bZbMBp1FEN2gTtQfYhoRplHLyWcZQpNWxRogLACaSeNHR6WoJOSptEA5kwiV5S4lqO7rvwXjda8qs86ehiuTfZbrU-TqE-BDqB7rqu7lEyV47lfRDodrpOge6tCHQA7z0KdNvPXuloAyfa20yrz-1ZD19pfbVSAhozmuaw6XFxznwORvRyvXvOf3D9v8NvAAAA__8axFww) on whether that will help or hurt his father's election campaign.
## Fed Hopeful for Interest Rate Cuts in 2024

Both the Bank of America and Deutsch Bank [released outlooks Monday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2zoyAUQH8Ndjhw-dKCYhu7bLulg3CN7Kpk4CZu_v2bl_q1Z05x5vy5zbeQ93zef4cDPa1lDpHyC2cpOYwc1Ky75FdEQNWhl05IsFY7123eOo1SjwOoKKRcU3Q2YLBmCcMwgFFd9iBASQmjFGY0sjfjupikjEto0S0j0wJTplL7vyWftOG6v8sLax_L0e1-I3o0pn4xmBhM13X1a_m_PFs-sbVvh8GEsZzleDOYlnD-4-HAmmPgCZ_U4sY_8FEx5Ug8n4QVG_EaCHl8UuMgQHfVp8eV9z0365gW9yPk_ZNAPx_5CgAA__9XXWPG) that predicted rate cuts next year as well, beginning by June, with potential further cuts later in the year.
## Sports Illustrated Accused of Fake Content
Sports Illustrated, one of America's most famous sports publications, [has been accused ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7tuxCAQAL8GOp94GGMKijTuLm1KizOLvRE2FqzvlL-PkrQpRyONNB_3-R4w47G-hx08pTKHhfAJs5Sdcp3Sc8-jTwAKNAcvrZBqGHpr-eatdgBajAFGZ3udzCKUAzNaJwwACI5eCaWlVE4K44y8GZceJmpjIwxgH471AiJSqbfPggdtkPJXeUK9LWXn2W9EZ2P6jamJqSlddFVs-49kampnqdQ6zPlqVANB7AJ2KxzwB6-KBLXx6uP5wpyxDZb1Yt0D5t8-_b_7HQAA__-PiFge)of using AI-generated content under the bylines of non-existent writers with AI-generated headshots. The magazine denies the claims while [admitting some articles](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDtuwzAQRE8jdTTIpT5hwSKNOqdNKfCzEjegSUFcO_DtAydtypnBAA_v87peHWUq-4e7oeWtri4wPXBVSoARoNehj3ZDBNQ9WjVLBdM0zHOfbPQaw1uECUc1eZBx0srAOHg1eAnB9GRBglYKjJKjGdVlNJsfox7niBPO3nSDxEhcz8tXpcIJt_ysDzwvod76bBPz0Tr93sHSwcIJE-X82jpYjpopPF81hlRqrvsrDFpLZWbRjnpyE5TzvfHpGKM4sR21xCa4ChfCvTmmWpogFsfdZ2oJo3Akdiz49wi1MBbuYOlPG49vypnaNHeD3G-OfkF6_t_ZTwAAAP__d09wIg) were published under fake names. The charges stem from an expose of the fictitious writers, who had no online history and whose bio pictures were found on a site featuring AI-generated stock photos. Sports Illustrated's staff has written [a letter of protest](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1ugzAUhZ8GNiP_AI4HD12ypWtHZOwL3MrYyL4JzdtXTaVO3Y50jo4-fR-36eYwYlrf3Q6Wljw5T_iASQgmDZNq6ttgFwAJqgUrNBdyHHut281q0Y9mNuB64Q0Hry_-InlQfORCuZm3aCWXSghpBB_MILrBLPMQ1KADjKBn0_QcAlIu3WfGRBss8ZkfUDqf9zbajeiojXpr5LWR1_M8uyV_JTjrT9_Iaz1yofoXGMZ4r1QcQWCHK5CI-bwfLj1ZgIRQ2XGfI9YN08ocshUS_K5dIfQRKpuj26Ey2rC8PujZFhuOE2PEOuqm5-vuML4A6X9f3wEAAP__koNwzA) to the publication's owners, who say a third-party vendor provided the content, which has been deleted from the site.

Before midnight tonight, I have to raise $46,300 to break even and cover our operational costs.

**[Will you pitch in and help us today?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e85cf7f9577243eba7c2bb4a64398383&_e=WW3H0epcJmbWBs_jkb7ICQvqFwQ0WZzPzxVUWlb-CIMjptSwpd6t0RK30nGGbfRsOsaQ2XmiAXswIt4YVGDbGUjA7RGD1vxdNuqMJGVEFvg8uA-aO9YF9QrYdLZGF-9cfUi9ZLQ-nmHWLggT51nhy6F98ZxvcGPIAUPh3Sb0EyQPLIWKiFCGmUAiS3h-4q4iA-0DbH3BkI8CFfxXeGvqvW-TQPKRazjiVRT7ZrvYienk7ftFmvLIIuwEnpVa0MJCUNr7OmCFjutDuC-1ksoLMKbBFaOZTT2UgIKIPBBoW7MrmmEIYo0B_bACX_y5BqDvIvA4QU22w4ApiSpGS7nuYYpb4mYeWSEdfZxWn_mKdX4EOe8E9Z1Ojbp7hAkn4h8W)**

There are a few reasons why newsrooms around the country have stopped doing investigative journalism. The first is the massive cost.

Most journalists today always stay in the comfort of their office. They gather reports from the Internet, make a few calls, and regurgitate news already cycling around the web.

It's lazy and serves no purpose other than clickbait for ad dollars for these big corporations who control the news.

At OMG, we're not doing that. Not even close.

We have teams of journalists deployed at nearly any given moment. The planning of our investigations is extraordinary. We will contact hundreds, if not thousands, of potential sources to find THE right one.

And then the filming starts!

The phone bill for our "swiping" campaign alone is thousands of dollars each month to maintain connections on arrays of phones we use to locate and communicate with sources.

The bills keep coming in, and we must be a team to keep going. **[You support OMG](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e85cf7f9577243eba7c2bb4a64398383&_e=WW3H0epcJmbWBs_jkb7ICQvqFwQ0WZzPzxVUWlb-CIMjptSwpd6t0RK30nGGbfRsOsaQ2XmiAXswIt4YVGDbGUjA7RGD1vxdNuqMJGVEFvg8uA-aO9YF9QrYdLZGF-9cfUi9ZLQ-nmHWLggT51nhy6F98ZxvcGPIAUPh3Sb0EyQPLIWKiFCGmUAiS3h-4q4iA-0DbH3BkI8CFfxXeGvqvXn1wsHnjrzqgo78NNqKtbOncHeSG52KZ_ODS3k5GURVZfb1D49D9Y186IwU7M2TKNSidsd_rgZb7OrmBTd8njUKfibU8ddDYbE_jQAKu1SEJSU_3VgbxNXkXSODAi9k2u3TKDhUfKCLzRPBKdof5gyXHU-Sf0wVw3GaXJfr3HjI), and we produce for you to get the truth to the public.**

We're not beholden to advertisers or ANY interests that will silence or dilute our reporting.

Friend, I have an unspoken agreement between you and a small group of other Americans who support my work. It's simple: **you support our reporting and truth in our integrity, and we work tirelessly to expose the truth.**

**[Will you chip in today to help me reach my goal by midnight tonight?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e85cf7f9577243eba7c2bb4a64398383&_e=WW3H0epcJmbWBs_jkb7ICQvqFwQ0WZzPzxVUWlb-CIMjptSwpd6t0RK30nGGbfRsOsaQ2XmiAXswIt4YVGDbGUjA7RGD1vxdNuqMJGVEFvg8uA-aO9YF9QrYdLZGF-9cfUi9ZLQ-nmHWLggT51nhy6F98ZxvcGPIAUPh3Sb0EyQPLIWKiFCGmUAiS3h-4q4iA-0DbH3BkI8CFfxXeGvqvWoEjAFiii0CmH28Ct7MBve5u1A6-ySgILay57do-xMGWvEkpm3M-Op4KyzpPqM53A3oHrYd6uP8yR4r6xSucYLOGJRcjeNN73aKyhx2aKWce0iaGBdB1U9M6X0UYWkvRjcULBd-E8H5uCASBFoT8lB-JD6i4mx_fVaHZFUBSIse)**

After watching the undercover footage, OMG's latest report has sent shivers up my spine.

It's horrendous stuff going on behind the back of the public, outside of the law, and outside of human decency.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d77476f6e1a540fcae8e16b3e893b3f3&_e=2zTpf71hvgePm5FFcU1wRnpV6QW5cNDY1kpU5RbEKs3Nu3piLlvO6K3pHNiZXz4PdBFWJWRawd7Wn8PAoNVyakt1tRiCWbiQcAe9xADfC5w-X1irBeoixD_SkrV4RsAVke4eLsOfipooSgSK8sLI1BY4IjL4k__wQ8zlzVSIEpamLxYI0aEbhkMh_07Rcu7VRoBfIn04RDGTDnBiIFw38oJsZ2b-juVhFYTM8UpwNQwhqbSDlq5PM_JrtZHdygdyPvesi2fGgD0Lh3rm4st9mAoe9Awsr0blzk_48Hzx8ToD7VzHNMwnco7Pgot45FAoGyew8hQjqmgcVAOOOUbMmINM2uuYBO2WJZpbw1GNsOuWE7j-AMXtpWSr633kK8_kplw2s8R6ueovi-0ZI2x37yqi9HJdlCWeLVF5B9QyT38EXf1BeNj3JnFiQPAXzFaV)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d6b4816c0a643d190cc7090db9811ef&_e=ty44exyNlkJRZQDe8dr0VneGo_eXbybk8Q0Mf64zt9o_ojclIK7T08pkBbMtDI_aDXAZFyJlPgsQIrXRubzkV6FpjPBq9i6gmtrqp5haYISbxijBCVUI7H5fhRWeVMXwSxUGHHZltdzvwJfsxgdbHedi8NXXeveoUiLBIskNWLitM8id75873BcitQ3pP2BZKo4GDVxpybAZjCc-zSjaiTvjVejxkfEVO3GjHpZ3gVV1US6dz478SkKEI1_AfIoRrnoT3wXC2QTQLY7jMBl833HduqqEeXFO2Eh-Ri0Ro-gxJsAXy4RKGbdOe_P9q0vnOk-nVFSb76ivFdUYIHhoKL4a1u_ZPBQ5OWJpuxy76G9gCkx9k2MgLaX8sTs0zANlMLlUdWJaY9ZzyLre7tCGEp6zMAJFYNLs2A9QztamUun9bOJ6fF6pkM7kLGgu_Dq3)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d6b4816c0a643d190cc7090db9811ef&_e=ty44exyNlkJRZQDe8dr0VneGo_eXbybk8Q0Mf64zt9o_ojclIK7T08pkBbMtDI_aDXAZFyJlPgsQIrXRubzkV6FpjPBq9i6gmtrqp5haYISbxijBCVUI7H5fhRWeVMXwSxUGHHZltdzvwJfsxgdbHedi8NXXeveoUiLBIskNWLitM8id75873BcitQ3pP2BZKo4GDVxpybAZjCc-zSjaiTvjVejxkfEVO3GjHpZ3gVV1US6dz478SkKEI1_AfIoRrnoT3wXC2QTQLY7jMBl83_f_dx7gL8C3kSXPbuEWQaijxkuwENkmBKrt5UGuCVBgaty1fmBYqKdWKrxorfIH2t5JNMGJ4kkqZUsWnBSt9I9K0STKDQludPb8mcAqREvpaBI9WbsgaOEhP3gJQirhNgiOlfZ9gJgoHBXzqAwF7iz2acV-gaPz0VlhathPcQK-).

Gov. DeSantis and Gov. Newsom are going head-to-head to debate two visions for America tomorrow.

Chip in for Ron DeSantis TODAY

In case you haven't had time to look into the details, here's what you need to know:

Gavin Newsom has touted his failing liberal policies and turned California into a leftist haven for drugs, crime, and the woke mob. Back in Ronald Reagan's day, it was a Republican haven.

Ron DeSantis has turned Florida from a swing state to a deep Red state by standing up for families, fighting back against woke indoctrination, and achieving record economic growth for the people he serves.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2bc9459c1b0f86301d5089abcc966078fed1c15cb28401f46b6257167bbf5e3bcf573a9cc789bd8c2ec290829f5ce18d14244e11dd6973c8915ebd3f1cc0e8ca

The American people deserve this debate. They deserve to hear about the future the Republican party is fighting for. Ron DeSantis is stepping up to make sure everyone in this country gets the chance to hear about it.

We are counting on you to make sure we can reach as many people as we can leading up to the big night. We need to show the nation that our entire team and every Republican is backing Team DeSantis as he FIGHTS against the Democrats for our freedom.

In Freedom,

Team DeSantis

Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2bc9459c1b0f86301d5089abcc966078fed1c15cb28401f46b6257167bbf5e3bcf573a9cc789bd8c2ec290829f5ce18d14244e11dd6973c8915ebd3f1cc0e8ca

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2bc9459c1b0f86301d5089abcc966078fed1c15cb28401f46b6257167bbf5e3bcf573a9cc789bd8c2ec290829f5ce18d14244e11dd6973c8915ebd3f1cc0e8ca

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Now we urgently need your help to close the gap before it’s too late.** Here’s why your matched gift matters so much today: Big Polluters are harming communities around the world at this very minute. Vulnerable species and our planet are depending on Friends of the Earth to protect them from irreversible damage from Big Polluters. Falling short means we have to scale back our fight while greedy corporations ramp up their planet-killing destruction for the sake of profits. We can’t let that happen. To be honest, Friend, we’re really worried. **We set our goal to hit $200,000 before our Giving Tuesday deadline because that’s the MINIMUM we need to stand up to Big Polluters.** There’s no fluff in our budget, just the dollars and cents it takes to show up and fight when ecosystems and communities are under attack. **If we fall short, that fight gets infinitely harder. And we feel the impact in polluted communities, poisoned waterways, toxic farmland, and the growing absence of endangered species.**
That’s not the world we want to live in. We can’t afford it, and neither can the precious species counting on us to do the right thing. **That’s why this match extension is such a critical opportunity to help protect the planet we all share. But we only have until 11:59 p.m. TONIGHT to make up our fundraising shortfall, and we’re relying on activists like you who know how much is at stake.**
**Please: Rush your $27 membership gift now before our rare match EXTENSION expires at midnight tonight, and every dollar will be doubled – up to $200,000 – to power the fight for our only Earth! **

name: House Speaker Mike Johnson
subject: I’ll let you in on a secret:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
My fellow Americans – this is Mike Johnson.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I'm humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z63hre8dnbm7q2g3v3vu0vp6mpfgok36si86b7ng_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jmeo71c9h2bs "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf0agia7c0fsvg5aadnbod75feku90d9n72eangg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jmeo71c9h2bs "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd6s8j3gk34jhvs8tktubdg5b0s5v4m664vfqhvo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jmeo71c9h2bs "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

That will be the difference between victory and defeat. So what do you say? Can I count you in?
---
**[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjfut112jkm2upqpu3vf140388b14g3p90v4khbo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jmeo71c9h2bs)[**YES >>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqobe9tmitg81ijptugijd4beakb8b7r9qaj2e40_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jmeo71c9h2bs)_[**NO >>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3o6m26h8hj3cir2ll8dasvemfli68mlil2lbhs8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jmeo71c9h2bs)**
---
Thanks for all you do.

In liberty,
Speaker Mike Johnson

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zph8nj517b0uhtucnbfa0euqeejtpnea3ca2gvp8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jm9o34cph2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdbjvr8krbvjmrank9a65gtro08cjn0aebcheav0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jm9o34cph2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2kju3i042nkeskbb2k1dqvq36qlq35hnth9r0b8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9jm9o34cph2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

1600 Daily

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

| | Hello my friend, , it's been a minute! First, I can’t begin to tell you how grateful I am right now. Over the past few months I have been traveling all the country speaking on behalf of Rural Americans on the needs and requirements to ensure success reaches every community and every household. I have been extremely encouraged by the investments I've seen take place, money that was approved and passed through President Biden's American Rescue Plan, The Bipartisan Infrastructure Bill & The Chip Act is finding it's way into our communities. If you're like me, you are seeing construction work go on all around you. Buildings being built, roads getting fixed, new Jobs being created everyday but, if you're like me you're also seeing it cost more to fill your car up, one hundred dollars at the grocery store just isn't stretching like it use to. I am so excited for everything that is happening in America, all of the great steps forward we are taking. However, at the same time I'm scared that while we are stepping forward there are some that are trying to take us back. It's only when we come together united in thought and purpose that we can create that more perfect union. A place where;
* Education for our children isn't limited by their zip-code
* Our seniors & veterans can retire with dignity and respect
* Unions and workers are supported and encouraged
* First-time home buyers can actually afford a starter home
* The family unit is strengthened & the rights of men & women are respected

America is calling out for healing, and I am determined to act as it's spiritual doctor. I am so encouraged by democrats from across the country who are donating in droves to launch this campaign and surge us to victory. We’re so close to hitting our $50,000 launch week goal But we need you! [Let's be honest, I can't win this thing without you and we just need $6,352 more before midnight to reach this goal. | | I'm from a small town called Hawkinsville Georgia, about 30 miles south of Macon. As a child those 30 miles seemed like an eternity away. I was raised by a single mom who did everything she could to keep me in school and out of trouble. Sometimes, it seemed like trouble was waiting for me outside on the daily. But I was lucky I had four amazing grandparents who kept me going on the right path. Going through High School & College I took part in everything I could join. From football, the debate team, student government. My dream was to one day become a Marine and be a doctor. But life stepped in, I never did make it to the marines and med-school wasn't in the cards for me. I found myself on mission trips, preaching and studying divinity and theology. The next thing I knew I was preaching under my grandfather and uncles. Over the last few years my dedication to service has grown exponentially. I got involved and got ready. I'm running for Congress because I'm ready to serve. To show more kids from small towns in South Georgia that they have the opportunity to reach their version on the American dream. From day one the odds have been stacked against me - and every time I've beaten the odds. Now its time to face the next challenge: taking on Austin Scott. Trust me, I know it wont be easy, but at my core I believe that we deserve so much more. The Eighth district deserves someone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and actually work with the constituents. Austin Scott's main focus is getting re-elected, my only focus will be helping people like you. But I can't win this thing alone: [That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a founding donor of my campaign on day one. We’re going to need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Austin Scott and I’m counting on you to be a part of it. name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhktltkrhlejk2i62qrqki27f65cj2brvkgqt40o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9ge0o76c9h2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zq4bmju1ukhtqipsiesv9kgkhgn23f1jrnlotkr0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9ge0o76c9h2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zh0i6i2sdp9i37r4va1cotgumfffdo6fiar5dbl0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9ge0o76c9h2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

Pro Life Update
---

Friends,
The American Dream of freedom, opportunity and safety for our families is degrading at a rapid pace.
When I ran for Congress in 2020, I made a promise to continuously fight to renew the American Dream for my children, grandchildren, and you. Although I was unsuccessful, I cannot sit by and watch the American dream erode. American freedoms are being taken...our kid's minds are being abused to pursue an agenda, those in need are suffering from political ping pong, Christians are being silenced, the dollar is fading, the economy is crumbling, and American pride is eroding.
I'm a father, grandfather, Christian, American. Just like you. If we do not fight, we might as well give up.
Just a few short weeks ago, my son called and reminded me that my fight is not finished. This country, this state, is too precious to sit by.
The Renew the American Dream PAC is the road for us all to fight together.
As parents, grandparents, conservatives, Christians, and Americans, if we do not act, we will forever pass on a message of hopelessness, dependency, and fear.
Please join me in supporting this effort. The American Dream is too important for us to watch it die.
Please consider clicking below to give $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can to save our future.
Respectfully,
Dale Crafts Former Candidate for Congress, ME-02

| It's no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms stack up so you can decide on the fit for you.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PPVDmejoCDU9q3ld7zctNA~~/AARclAA~)
### Overview of Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab
Vanguard made a name for itself by creating and offering low-fee investment products such as mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). It still does this, and even non-Vanguard clients can buy Vanguard funds via a brokerage account. The firm has grown to now offer non-proprietary investment products and funds.

Fidelity is perhaps best known for its personal investment products, namely brokerage accounts that allow users to trade stocks. Clients can invest in a wide range of stocks, bonds and other investment products using a Fidelity brokerage account. Fidelity also makes an effort to provide investment resources to its clients and doesn't usually charge fees on all trades, though more and more brokerages and broker-dealers are moving toward fee-free investment models.

Schwab has a number of passively and actively managed funds that you can invest your money into. You also have the option to trade individual equities. It also offers free robo-advisor services, and those who want to work with a real advisor will have that option as well. [Learn how the fees compare here.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PPVDmejoCDU9q3ld7zctNA~~/AARclAA~)

### How to Speak With a Financial Advisor

If you're interested in getting financial advice, consulting a fiduciary financial advisor can be a great first step. That's why SmartAsset created a [free tool](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/D4OSnniofxvf1GQ9owtlhQ~~/AARclAA~_2QGdlamyYZVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) to help match you with up to three financial advisors who serve your area. All advisors on the matching platform have been rigorously vetted through a proprietary due diligence process.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor feel more at ease about their finances and could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1 It's never too late to work towards a more comfortable retirement.

# ICYMI: John Teichert Talks Candidacy for U.S. Senate
**BALTIMORE, Md.** \- In case you missed it, retired Brigadier General, John Teichert, candidate for the U.S. Senate spoke to Gannett about his bid to represent Marylanders in the senate.
Described as a “military man” with strong leadership skills and a new perspective on Maryland policy, State Sen. Johnny Ray Salling of Baltimore County said of Teichert, “having the leadership skills that he has, I believe he could be a great leader in the U.S. Senate.”
The retired general emphasized his commitment to the four pillar issues of his campaign: national security, crime and public safety, the economy, and education. While traveling around Maryland discussing issues with voters from around the state to learn their greatest concerns, Teichert said, “it really struck me that those issues, the four big ones, are the same for what people care about in Maryland- everyone kept coming back to those.”
While Gannett notes that Teichert approached his campaign with a level of precision expected of someone in his station, those who know him aren’t surprised. The General’s business associate, Jason Korman, said Teichert was “probably the best military leader I’ve ever met in my life.”
Teichert’s bid for the U.S. Senate comes at a time where Marylanders are desperate for leadership, not politics in Washington. With prominent Democratic officials in the state, a Republican candidacy has been deemed “an uphill climb”- one Teichert is capable of overcoming.
Read more about [General Teichert’s bid for the US Senate here](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=c5943eaa00&e=1b1fb1ad9f).

clean_body: | | | | | ICYMI: John Teichert Talks Candidacy for U.S. Senate BALTIMORE, Md. \- In case you missed it, retired Brigadier General, John Teichert, candidate for the U.S. Senate spoke to Gannett about his bid to represent Marylanders in the senate. Described as a “military man” with strong leadership skills and a new perspective on Maryland policy, State Sen. Johnny Ray Salling of Baltimore County said of Teichert, “having the leadership skills that he has, I believe he could be a great leader in the U.S. Senate.” The retired general emphasized his commitment to the four pillar issues of his campaign: national security, crime and public safety, the economy, and education. While traveling around Maryland discussing issues with voters from around the state to learn their greatest concerns, Teichert said, “it really struck me that those issues, the four big ones, are the same for what people care about in Maryland- everyone kept coming back to those.” While Gannett notes that Teichert approached his campaign with a level of precision expected of someone in his station, those who know him aren’t surprised. The General’s business associate, Jason Korman, said Teichert was “probably the best military leader I’ve ever met in my life.” Teichert’s bid for the U.S. Senate comes at a time where Marylanders are desperate for leadership, not politics in Washington. With prominent Democratic officials in the state, a Republican candidacy has been deemed “an uphill climb”- one Teichert is capable of overcoming. clean_body: | | | Fellow American, Because I’m a woman. Because I’m hispanic. Because I’m the daughter of immigrants. These are all the reasons the “squad” thinks I should be one of them. But they’re also some of the very reasons I’m a Republican. I’m conservative because I’m a mother who wants to keep my children safe. I’m conservative because I don’t want my heritage erased for the Left’s woke narrative. I’m conservative because my parents escaped socialism in Cuba, and I’ll never let the country that we owe our lives to go down the same path. There’s no “one way” to be a Republican: conservatism is for everyone who has common sense. But because I’m such a loud proponent of freedom, socialists in Congress are out to get me. | | | | | | Socialism had NEVER worked. Not now, not ever. Yet at the expense of the American people, the “squad” is desperate to try it one more time. I love America far too much to let them get away with that. | | | | | | Thank you, Maria Elvira Salazar | | | | Paid for by Salazar for Congress | | Unsubscribe from future emails

Ron DeSantis is taking the fight straight to the Democrats for a
live debate. Will you be tuning in? Here's a preview.

Friend,

Gov. DeSantis and Gov. Newsom are going head-to-head to debate
two visions for America tomorrow.

Chip in for Ron DeSantis TODAY

In
case you haven't had time to look into the details, here's what
you need to know:

Gavin Newsom has touted his failing liberal policies and turned
California into a leftist haven for drugs, crime, and the woke
mob. Back in Ronald Reagan's day, it was a Republican haven.

Ron
DeSantis has turned Florida from a swing state to a deep Red
state by standing up for families, fighting back against woke
indoctrination, and achieving record economic growth for the
people he serves.

The
American people deserve this debate. They deserve to hear about
the future the Republican party is fighting for. Ron DeSantis is
stepping up to make sure everyone in this country gets the chance
to hear about it.

We
are counting on you to make sure we can reach as many people as
we can leading up to the big night. We need to show the nation
that our entire team and every Republican is backing Team
DeSantis as he FIGHTS against the Democrats for our freedom.

Donate $25 today to reach thousands

This is a debate for revival vs. decline. The American people
have a choice to make. Let's make sure they know their options.

In
Freedom,

Team DeSantis

Donate to the campaign before 11/30

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.
