7 Directions of Service will be joining a delegation of 28 people from the Indigenous Environmental Network (IEN) leaders from Indigenous frontline community representatives dealing with environmental issues to the city of Dubai on the Persian Gulf Coast | | |
Greetings from Crystal and Jason,
7 Directions of Service will be joining a delegation of 28 people from the Indigenous Environmental Network (IEN) leaders from Indigenous frontline community representatives dealing with environmental issues to the city of Dubai on the Persian Gulf Coast for the 28th Conference of Parties. From November 30, 2023 – December 12, 2023, the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change ([UNFCCC](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/Mqag7sW8TIW-nixyBdulQmyscn2kLVh7MNjd3NGX6rRRf3Iq0wozY4Sgs7C7KYUpjGSlXSXQN7gjJKSVxxsSmLA0MU-qoVftFb0t8VjnPdUzluoWQ1E8m36S4QGqk32g0bmvLJknBbJKESg50gOoW8wJOxM7cvo8P9IGtqUHmdeRkDgsV7rpow9RyKz5L_pTmLEUO55sxcXyhP3aerdPikTEnEg5ZzKR6BQvVG50vuH4pVOCzTF71Dhtp4cx6LyqW3ffCykaQsyW3smr0wFqmOGF0MZN6SeC_Dd1ERsu51DXl5lFZmjqTrsy3AvDiDgfKnCrnjwrjKNK9ETBnVV_BuOWTcpAfTLN8GStZgtfv66JAKpEiZUtL-rroiGisSLYy4g06zmDhmfkeEuaLUGZRVhoIWfi6dA5X6G7mhOwdE1VLGYrSDaKG-p4iJ3dHJiCoRscuki38S54qP75ZBeYZg/41p/rc2uRkEGRRm6Ih4UjLSlBw/h0/eHRm2UIGgTkHG73S517fF245a3l684pSjOFBlZn-ILk)) Conference of Parties [(COP28)](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/Mqag7sW8TIW-nixyBdulQmyscn2kLVh7MNjd3NGX6rRRf3Iq0wozY4Sgs7C7KYUpjGSlXSXQN7gjJKSVxxsSmLA0MU-qoVftFb0t8VjnPdVIFIT0PqhM_GeUNsxU1WTcLm52kDriet8320YThpBztSVK6opyo9aemNk3hmwgTUsTXQZLs2VciBzaquOuqKKlZzGjJZkO9-ijPvcKUxXqemnugZt5szbe4qm5LYlQUSVyas_Y1nyEWC1606FGkI20trIJMa36HIWsCc65DjqP1eIavkQmroL0yNiGXmBg0Ar7KyC7dQuIo31ycDFDW0Q6GZWnOTg8j_wRpIcUTJyY97U8-9S0trkjdii-WoW2WxUC9jNXQSGUwHaF3mIo6atb-78gXmXhJKyDh72EHuRQtMzrQC92kDjioWSEl01hsgzC96qnk5PrjScEOtrvOiW_SCdlg-3aeaFwq6aB1N_KYQ/41p/rc2uRkEGRRm6Ih4UjLSlBw/h1/M5NauTpDUxiZrbCmNYS7qUiwZrHvNWyLgaZCwHeJYv8) is happening in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Indigenous representation is essential in moving world leaders to take immediate action on climate change, and that is why members of our team will be attending to join the Indigenous Peoples' Caucus and other Indigenous and allied leaders in pushing policymakers for urgent and holistic responses to climate chaos. Proactive efforts to center, resource, and respect Indigenous rights, leadership, and stewardship must be prioritized in all layers of decision-making as we collectively engage to combat climate change. 7 Directions of Service will have an in-person delegation that includes Executive Director **Crystal Cavalier-Keck (Occaneechi Band of Saponi Nation)** and Co-Founder **Jason Campos-Keck.****Follow us on Facebook or Instagram** as we share Indigenous voices from the ground and report on key actions and takeaways from COP28. In its first two years, the Biden administration outpaced Trump’s approval of oil and gas permits for drilling on public lands, contradicting climate science that fossil fuel growth must end and governments must phase out fossil fuels to avoid global Climate Chaos. Meanwhile, the fossil fuels infrastructure continues to be expanded as global temperatures rise annually, with the summer and fall of 2023 being the hottest ever on record and November 18 seeing a global temperature rise above 2C for the first time.____ At COP28, we will present diverse visions, projects, reports, frameworks, and strategies to build a healthy and equitable world. During COP28, we will be advocating for:
* Climate Justice
* Equitable, Fair, and financed fossil fuel phaseout
* Indigenous rights and sovereignty
* Forest protection and restoration
* Just Transition
* Rights of Nature
* Holding Insurance, Corporations, and Financial institutions accountable
* Denouncing carbon offsets and false solutions

body:
Pennsylvanians aren’t going to be fooled by this carpetbagger.
Can you f*$&ing believe this, Peter?
**Bob Casey (ya know, the Pennsylvania map guy) is running against a mega-millionaire who doesn’t even live in Pennsylvania.** You read that right. David McCormick is a hedge fund executive who has been lying about where he lives (CONNECTICUT!!).
I’m setting the record straight. McCormick has been selling out workers in order to get rich – making MILLIONS on Wall Street off the backs of the very people Senator Casey has been fighting for his entire career.
But McCormick’s sh*tty record doesn’t stop there. He even said he supports an extreme abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest.
Pennsylvanians aren’t going to be fooled by this carpetbagger. But in order to show voters who David McCormick really is, we need resources.

subject: Please Join Us at Finley’s in Huntington on Wednesday, December 13th
body:
https://jimgaughran.com/ [https://jimgaughran.com/]
Dear Peter,
I am reaching out to invite you to an event my friends in Huntington are hosting for my campaign for US Congress. I hope you can join us! You can RSVP HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/121323gaughrancatchall] .
The event will take place at Finley’s of Greene Street in Huntington on Wednesday, December 13th from 6:30PM to 8:30PM . Here’s the address: 43 Greene St Huntington, NY 11579.
I am running in New York’s First Congressional District in Suffolk County, which combines Suffolks’ North Shore communities with the Hamptons. The DCCC has called NY-1 a 2024 District In Play, which means that it has potential to be won by either party. NY-1 is one of the 18 districts that President Biden won in 2020 that is currently represented by a Republican in Congress. It is one of the most competitive districts in the country.
Having represented this community for many years at the state and local level, I know what it takes to flip NY-1 Blue. My Republican opponent, Nick Lalota, is pro-Trump, pro-gun lobby and ready to ban abortion nationally. I have protected reproductive rights, passed gun safety measures, and safeguarded Long Island’s environment. As a Long Island native and former State Senator, I am ready to put in the work to win this race.
Please RSVP to the event at this link! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/121323gaughrancatchall]
You can reach out to Emily Sherron at emily@bhstrategiesllc.com [emily@bhstrategiesllc.com] or 713-213-1922 with any questions.
I hope to see you on December 13th!
Best,
Jim

body:

Peter,
If you’re getting this email, it’s because you care about Democrats winning elections . But here in Suffolk County, it’s no secret that we haven’t been doing a lot of winning lately. So what gives?
First let’s face the facts - Republicans have preyed on real voter concerns about crime and the economy here to put Democrats on the defensive. Right-wing nonsense talking points have dominated the discussion, and that has hurt us.
But it doesn’t have to be that way. Not when they tolerate mass murder by opposing basic gun safety laws, and not when they defund police by looking to cut resources for the FBI. We don’t have to let them act concerned about economic pain when it was Republicans who eliminated SALT deductions for Long Island’s middle class just to cut taxes for their rich donors.
Meanwhile, under President Biden, Democrats have brought record infrastructure investment back to America. We are the party that has presided over massive gains in employment, and beat back inflation.
We need candidates who can fight back, and who have a proven track record of weathering negative attacks and winning anyway. I’ve done that time and again, and I’ll do it in my run for Congress.
Look, we can’t afford to lose on Long Island next year - or Republicans will once again control the House of Representatives . That’s why we need to nominate Democrats who have a track record of success in tough races. I’ve been through it all - and knocked thousands of doors every campaign to make sure voters knew what I was really about.
I’m asking for your support because I’m here to win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jim-gaughran-4-congress]
Please donate today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jim-gaughran-4-congress]
Thank you,
Jim

Peter,

Political retribution for exposing Donald Trump’s Russia and Ukraine misconduct and for holding him accountable during his first impeachment trial.

Unfortunately, it’s clear the GOP still sees me as their biggest threat — because the attacks haven’t stopped.

Just last week, Trump just attacked me in Iowa, now Sean Hannity and Kid Rock are piling on.

**As you can see, these MAGA attacks are getting more and more desperate by the day, Peter.** They know how effective I am, so they are prepared to throw every dirty trick in the book to sabotage my campaign for truth and justice — especially as the election gets closer.

**But like I said on the House floor when they censured me: I am honored to have earned their enmity. I am flattered by their falsehoods. And I will not yield. Not one inch.**

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After Justice Democrats supported AOC’s victory against the establishment,
the DCCC responded with the blacklist, refusing to work with any vendors
that supported primary challengers to Democratic incumbents.

Now, candidates funded by corporate PACs and right-wing megadonors are
lining up to challenge progressive incumbents like Cori Bush, Summer Lee,
and Jamaal Bowman in their primary elections next year — and the
Democratic Party hasn’t made a peep.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231129.Ulh2qs&refcode=em20231129-32083&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32083%2E1203867%2E0y-PIB ]We can’t rely on the Democratic establishment to defend the Squad,
which is why we need to prepare for the fights ahead in 2024 NOW. Can you
rush $3 or more to help us reach our end-of-month goal and
fuel our work to re-elect progressive champions?

House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries — who received more than $280,000
from AIPAC and Pro-Israel America PAC in 2022 alone — had a problem when
our people-powered movement challenged the status quo by primarying
out-of-touch moderate incumbents in 2018 and 2020.

But when asked about outside groups like AIPAC threatening to spend $100
million to unseat this group of Black and brown, progressive,
working-class incumbents in 2024, Jeffries responded, “Outside groups are
gonna do what outside groups are gonna do.”

The double standard is obvious and shameful. While the Party fails to
stand up for the Squad, we’re staying focused on doing everything in our
power to defend them from groups like AIPAC and Moderate PAC, who are
funded by GOP millionaires and supported 109 Republicans who voted to
overturn the 2020 presidential election.

midnight, can you chip in any amount today to help us reach our email

Thank you for powering our grassroots movement to protect and expand our
bloc of young, diverse, and working-class progressives in Congress. We
couldn’t do this without you.

— Justice Democrats

We the people have your backs on this and will support you! Thank you.”_

Friend,

| | _**_Meet Tom Cotton_**_

Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate.

The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory.

After clerking on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and spending a short time in private law practice, he joined the United States Army as an Infantry Officer, spending nearly five years on active duty.

Between his two combat tours he served as a platoon leader with the Old Guard at Arlington National Cemetery, the unit responsible for military honors funerals.

Tom's military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab.

In the U.S. Senate, he's fighting the tough battles for Arkansans and Americans, and delivering real results. He knows that only the strong can survive in a dangerous world, and he's building a movement to make America strong again.

And we’re proud to have Blue Amp Action's support in this mission. [Now that we’re all set on furniture, we’re focusing on growing our grassroots movement to elect more young people across the country. We’re still counting on your support, so will you split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action to help?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47dc9b16-696c-4e49-a6b8-55f719ca4b33/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

_**A personal note for Peter from Christina Reynolds:**_

Peter, we're under a year out from Election Day, so I wanted to reach out directly.

| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I'm humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=24dc9a184bd84dd5b842cd083858b7a8&_e=dosbwhPCf1CMsJczmjk_HckWTaPtQN_vF9eORkBxfUt8Wfh5R1D5nAUXO8m01nVIn0R9zWlxgOye0t5pRfwofeSg1L1IwO-cBYd6zH6BlFygalbqvWR2zCNGLrZX73i4jFTGyZF26w5dHrfkjE44bUnyOdqV-cqY1I0bOi2EVhBRYztO_2SChVuUnFpdrWq7TZy0B_-HsBq8At5KjrFHcsiaLZGPUmqg0Cq-FsvVZwh6wHptGwxpUb-cVMtHVHhaHW-ZAI_U9fDOAjS_2m1DnhtwBIMGMXQozFQbUIsQFWK7wf-lHdxo82vRRY2bkIuT_Waw9GiDJeVuLH_JpilQURTdaoCV0hWUBLblCtvOWFG510ms09Z8VvI_l7kd0zZSkZMkAN3JFNsw5vQUJE-ignHHURKHLE0MuhxSSAj9hDR3Pi61Wq_Y-NPpdQ2ZWxzsMhNwy886CimCcTgikrzn2eEiunVmvoGjjUmn2L4iJQk%3D "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=24dc9a184bd84dd5b842cd083858b7a8&_e=dosbwhPCf1CMsJczmjk_HckWTaPtQN_vF9eORkBxfUt8Wfh5R1D5nAUXO8m01nVIn0R9zWlxgOye0t5pRfwofeSg1L1IwO-cBYd6zH6BlFygalbqvWR2zCNGLrZX73i4jFTGyZF26w5dHrfkjE44bUnyOdqV-cqY1I0bOi2EVhBRYztO_2SChVuUnFpdrWq7TZy0B_-HsBq8At5KjrFHcsiaLZGPUmqg0Cq-FsvVZwh6wHptGwxpUb-cVMtHVHhaHW-ZAI_U9fDOAjS_2m1DnhtwBIMGMXQozFQbUIsQFWK7wf-lHdxo82vRRY2bkIuT4Zux6E7i80r-Q7qdWDaDe9q8T-SHmWEuSkklNcNf_LdEs5XNz-Hxy65nxfGChWqy3gROYoldRQH3Z0yAMSeLpIXF8HxA7IEqpj3WsQ6bdmJPwCEHr3q0bRQywE-yVQDwLKyi2a362dnkPSp4Qv7cSm-zbEr26keNjcpnoba_9j4%3D "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=24dc9a184bd84dd5b842cd083858b7a8&_e=dosbwhPCf1CMsJczmjk_HckWTaPtQN_vF9eORkBxfUt8Wfh5R1D5nAUXO8m01nVIn0R9zWlxgOye0t5pRfwofeSg1L1IwO-cBYd6zH6BlFygalbqvWR2zCNGLrZX73i4jFTGyZF26w5dHrfkjE44bUnyOdqV-cqY1I0bOi2EVhBRYztO_2SChVuUnFpdrWq7TZy0B_-HsBq8At5KjrFHcsiaLZGPUmqg0Cq-FsvVZwh6wHptGwxpUb-cVMtHVHhaHW-ZAI_U9fDOAjS_2m1DnhtwBIMGMXQozFQbUIsQFWK7wf-lHdxo82vRRY2bkIuTRMkMJwfT1zMUF1twasyRn3j1uJwqvChrmgeOM-ZwXCPpDcVt6zv2ofKQt0zcLAEBdhturW5DqVxI98yfV_RkhRTW5LEkQw8kTNbscz2kmveQBE1I7y3_sfm0uhCM9Tk3rrD_0RXbkRGjvVfUvSYlV2RpOniVMZbBxxenCAx2Zak%3D "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

Hey Derek, it's John. I really need to talk to you about my friend Bob Casey.
2024 is approaching fast -- and next year, **the GOP's road to winning back the Senate runs right through PA.**
Republicans are zeroing in on next year's battleground states as we speak. You can bet Mitch McConnell and the GOP's shadiest billionaires will spend hundreds of million$ to attack Bob. 😨
This is *seriously* scary stuff, but you know what gives ME hope? This amazing grassroots team!!!!!
The way we stopped the GOP in 2022 is the same way we fight back and re-elect Bob now: by bringing together an ✨all-star grassroots team✨ that can stand up to the GOP's money by folks chipping in $5, $25, or more at a time.
Together, we'll defend PA's Senate seat, as long as we don't lose sight of the stakes. 💪 **Holding this seat is make-or-break for our Democratic majority.**

Hey friend, it's Ron DeSantis.

As you know, I'm running for President, and there are less than 12 months left in this race.

What we do with this time is up to us, but the biggest difference you could make is sending in a donation of any amount to my campaign. And if you're willing to step up and help me do what it takes to win today, I am going to send you this bumper sticker as a small token of my appreciation:

Send in just $5 today!

No matter the amount—whether it's $5 or $50—we use the budget our grassroots team sets us on track for to stay on pace. We get to plan our events, get our ads on air, invest in campaign materials to spread the word, and match the momentum of our growing team.

We know the sacrifice it's going to take to win next November, but we also know what we're facing if we don't give what we can today to save our country.

And when you decide to donate today, you join the special group of people who receive special offers, weekly investor reports about what's new in our campaign, and so much more to come.

I need your support, and I know I wouldn't be here today without it.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=12083e1ba0d9225afe6c56ddff922f66a38cfddb1f1b74677dfd18f56cc17b11ddcd934e9f824b20c651a5a7c62f46e7766073b1621ca75a19cb35aee330b7d4
Sign up to donate today

We have to recognize that we've got a long road ahead. The Iowa Caucus is right around the corner and it will only intensify from there on out.

I am counting on my team to come together now. Letting the Left continue to run laps around our party is not something I'm willing to stand by for. This is the fight of our lives, and it's worth every small investment.

Yours in Freedom,

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=12083e1ba0d9225afe6c56ddff922f66a38cfddb1f1b74677dfd18f56cc17b11ddcd934e9f824b20c651a5a7c62f46e7766073b1621ca75a19cb35aee330b7d4

Ron DeSantis

🚨 ATTENTION 🚨

Heads up! We have pre-checked the monthly donor box on our fundraising page. Monthly donors make a HUGE difference for our team and help ups plan ahead.

If one donation was all it took to defeat Joe Biden next November then we wouldn't ask for your help more than we already have, but unfortunately it's going to take more than that to win.

Please keep this box checked so we that we can count on your support.

Volunteer!

We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for.

Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today!

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=12083e1ba0d9225a78b10e0ede498a66ac6b4db607df63988fc04cdc1e807f8406598dc53de4868c4c8d7d00ee13c24cd33eef1e3039e44ac6b43c9ed2843fbb
Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=12083e1ba0d9225afe6c56ddff922f66a38cfddb1f1b74677dfd18f56cc17b11ddcd934e9f824b20c651a5a7c62f46e7766073b1621ca75a19cb35aee330b7d4

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=12083e1ba0d9225afe6c56ddff922f66a38cfddb1f1b74677dfd18f56cc17b11ddcd934e9f824b20c651a5a7c62f46e7766073b1621ca75a19cb35aee330b7d4

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

body:
United in the vision of a Kennedy Presidency and an America that yet may be.

| | |
#### Join Kennedy
---
---
**"Who knows if perhaps you were made for just such a time as this?" Mordecai to Esther, from _The_ _Book of Esther_** Dear Peter,
Perhaps you recall this quote from _Notes from the Campaign Trail_ , Amaryllis Kennedy’s thoughtful email. In reflecting upon the journey that led to her role in RFK Jr.’s campaign, she points out that each of us have undertaken our own journey that led us here as well. The journeys are as singular as each of us, yet they unite us in the vision of a Kennedy Presidency and that dream for America that almost was and yet still may be. As we anticipate the end of the year and the end of Q4 fundraising efforts, your support is vital to make our collective dream a reality. “...on every future day of our journey, I hope that you will ask yourself the same question... name: Mari at United We Dream Action
subject: DACA left my sister behind
body:
DACA was never enough — it left my sister out. | | | Peter, DACA is never going to be enough. Not for the millions who never got to apply, and not for the millions more who were never eligible, **like my little sister.** Immigrant youth are living in limbo — either living with temporary DACA protections (which will likely be in front of the Supreme Court before long) or no protections at all. If she had DACA protections, my little sister would be able to go to school and get financial aid. Her immigration status wouldn’t get in the way of applying for jobs, and she would be able to live her life free from worrying about deportation. DACA is life-changing, Peter. **But now more than ever, it’s not enough.** Millions of undocumented immigrants are shut out of the program. Even DACA recipients can’t rest easy, as the case is likely headed to the conservative Supreme Court. **We need permanent protections now — so we can apply for jobs, get an affordable education, access health care, and live our lives proudly and free from the threat of deportation.** United We Dream Action was part of the coalition that helped win DACA back in 2012, and we’re leading the charge to secure a pathway to citizenship for ALL undocumented people. **This fight isn’t easy, which is why I’m asking for your support today, during Giving Week: Will you chip in $10 or more to join our immigrant youth-led movement and support our fight for permanent protections?** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [express donate: $10](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953y62hYNn9HaFt_zHKvI4OP8CyraxqLLfAsc7Mu4MEH22nEZGSLCSm9HgCsMIZhMTf6RDFI8IEn6qVvhhlH1EYdnjEgs_hOnytUNg-3daCv151n8Qyie8WK9lbpkSDgt9_sP9_KYcOdYoteta2N2J7MIexWJ8xfCxvYQ54mh9y4ujAb2UMtMbk8InNumH7Ylc_Mk9tZMNppw4neSOnwB4J7Ii0Ph83zHkl7eOo8f0SyezglK0mC7ze2PlOBBu1-ukOtA1xIra0JcpaR-PSGSi5SNgDi0BdU22c5ZisS6ED99rxJCW1hsaOieCtzCmwUZjW8RgFh6HqbjtnJT-nYhaHLUX1IbZnoWzLmXGxz-snlxU81_aye1qnGZ5jrCttZTV_14j8M8YAtPFwKPYPpACe-E/41p/C7j1WqrURR2BV-PtlmxVSw/h0/aW_VioACgd9Yp6QspFsrt65cPZmjD8Kol9yK-PIx-Vo)

clean_body: DACA was never enough — it left my sister out. | | | Peter, DACA is never going to be enough. Not for the millions who never got to apply, and not for the millions more who were never eligible, like my little sister. Immigrant youth are living in limbo — either living with temporary DACA protections (which will likely be in front of the Supreme Court before long) or no protections at all. If she had DACA protections, my little sister would be able to go to school and get financial aid. Her immigration status wouldn’t get in the way of applying for jobs, and she would be able to live her life free from worrying about deportation. DACA is life-changing, Peter. But now more than ever, it’s not enough. Millions of undocumented immigrants are shut out of the program. Even DACA recipients can’t rest easy, as the case is likely headed to the conservative Supreme Court. We need permanent protections now — so we can apply for jobs, get an affordable education, access health care, and live our lives proudly and free from the threat of deportation. United We Dream Action was part of the coalition that helped win DACA back in 2012, and we’re leading the charge to secure a pathway to citizenship for ALL undocumented people. This fight isn’t easy, which is why I’m asking for your support today, during Giving Week: Will you chip in $10 or more to join our immigrant youth-led movement and support our fight for permanent protections? body:
| This fight is personal to me.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=1608%2E35263%2EUid_Ou)
Peter, you’ve probably heard about my health care story from when I was growing up by now. After spending three months in the hospital with an illness as a child, my grandparents, who raised me, couldn’t find an insurance policy to protect me — at any price, from any insurer — all because I had a **“pre-existing condition.”** I got into public service because I watched my grandparents make enormous sacrifices to pay for my health care out of pocket. I’ll never forget what it was like to watch them stay up late at night, worrying that if I fell ill again, they wouldn’t be able to afford the care to help me get better. Thanks to the _Affordable Care Act_ , 133 million Americans like me can no longer be denied coverage for having a pre-existing condition. I was proud to vote to pass that legislation, and have fought tooth and nail against Republican efforts to repeal it. **This fight is personal to me, Peter, so when I see Republicans like Donald Trump renew their attacks against the ACA, I know we can’t take these threats lightly.** The former president took aim at the _Affordable Care Act_ over the weekend, promising to “never give up” the fight to repeal it and take away affordable health care from millions of Americans. Republicans have tried — and failed — before to roll back health care reform, and I intend to fight them every step of the way to defend health care access for Americans with pre-existing conditions. But I’m counting on you to join me in this fight, Peter. If Mitch McConnell flips one more Senate seat, Republicans will retake the majority and pave the way to advance their out-of-touch, right-wing agenda which includes repealing the ACA. **[So I’m personally asking: Will you pitch in a donation to help me defend this toss-up Senate seat and our Democratic Senate majority? Dear Friend,
---
Kingdom Math— it doesn't always add up! The Widow at Zarephath had enough provisions for _one_ meal, and yet her oil and flour didn't run out. After a slow night fishing, Jesus told the disciples where to cast their nets, and their boat couldn't contain the catch. Jesus fed 5,000 with five loaves and two fish. _**When God is on the move, His math doesn't have to add up to us.**_** **

At Let Us Worship, we believe in Kindom Math, because we've seen the hand of God move in way's that don't add up. To fund the second half of our Kingdom to the Capitol tour, we are relying on God to make a way, where there isn't one. _**Here's a breakdown of the numbers: **_
__ _**We have 24 stops remaining**_ in 2024. **_Each revival costs around $97,000_** to pull off. This covers permitting, equipment rental, staging, travel, and the thousand other costs that arise.****_**24x$97,000 = $2,328,000.**_ Here's where the math gets tricky—last year we had a partner who helped cover a majority of the costs. They've since backed out, and we are left to cover the entire costs for 2024.

Should we charge an admission? $15 tickets could knock $750,000 off the bottom line. Absolutely not. From the beginning, Let Us Worship has been a grassroots movement, funded by Believers who want to see revival spread across America and the world.

So no, we still won't start charging admission to revivals, no matter the costs. We trust that God's plan doesn't include charging people an entrance fee to worship in His presence. We are putting out the call—help us fund another year of Let Us Worship. This Believer-supported ministry still has work to do, but we can't do it alone. We will rely on donations from Believers across the country, just like we have from the beginning. The pandemic may be over, but the Kingdom is still ripe for harvest, and we are ready to go!

bs-
Friend,
Earlier this month, I joined my friend, Congresswoman Hillary Scholten, in West Michigan to lead an announcement of her endorsement of my campaign. This endorsement in particular means a lot to me. Ever since Hillary flipped her seat in 2022, it has been wonderful to see her fight on behalf of West Michiganders, and help pave the Democratic infrastructure in the fast-growing (and traditionally Republican) part of the state.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov23-scholten.bWmrnt&refcode=em231129-1-tt&t=2&akid=861%2E135344%2ELKqiCv)
I am thankful for Hillary’s endorsement, and I am writing with the hope that I can earn your support as well.
Let me get you caught up on where things currently stand in this Senate race. Since the great Senator Debbie Stabenow announced that she was retiring, things have really heated up in Michigan: **CNN named us one of the 10 Senate seats most likely to flip in 2024, and top political insiders are saying that Michigan is the state _most likely to decide the presidential election.**_
And over the last two months, we’ve seen three serious Republican candidates enter the race: former Congressman Mike Rogers, former Detroit Police Chief James Craig, and former Grand Rapids Congressman Peter Meijer, who represented this area before Hillary. All three have unfortunately done the predictable thing and immediately started saying whatever they can to appeal to the most extreme parts of the GOP, in order to win.
But the Senate majority isn’t the only thing on the line in 2024. Experts are already saying that Hillary’s district in West Michigan remains a battleground in the fight for the House majority, and Republican groups are already spending big in their efforts to unseat Hillary. And, as I alluded to, West Michigan has really become a political powerhouse in the state, making success there instrumental in my efforts to win statewide.
All of the above is why I would love to earn your support on behalf of mine and Hillary’s campaigns. [**Any chance you’d split a $5 donation between Hillary Scholten and my campaign for Senate in Michigan?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov23-scholten.bWmrnt&refcode=em231129-1-tt&t=3&akid=861%2E135344%2ELKqiCv)** Your support has a huge impact as we continue to build a grassroots team to defend this open Senate seat and win back the House.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: They want you to forget
body:
The radical Left wants you to forget.

| |
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd0eth2krsd0io6uuqb30e1vsguu9d51p2kammbo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9ieeo36cph2bs)
---
Fellow American,The radical Left wants you to forget.They want you to forget how wrong they were about COVID. They want you to forget that they lied to your face for over a year. They want you to forget that they let extremists riot in the streets while they told you to skip holidays with your loved ones and to “social distance.”They want you to forget how they closed our schools, our businesses, and our houses of worship. (Gavin Newsom even closed Orange County beaches). **And maybe most of all, they want you to forget that thousands of hardworking, competent people either lost their jobs or were forced to take a vaccine they didn’t want.****They want you to forget that...** _...And I hope you never do._ Because if you forget what they did, it’s only a matter of time before they do it again.It’s only a matter of time before they find a new reason to trample your rights and your freedoms for the so-called “greater good.”We can’t forget what the radical Left and its draconian policies did to us and to our families – and we can’t let them forget it either. **That’s why the Center for American Liberty is still putting their feet to the fire and holding them accountable.** But nothing we do is possible without the generosity of patriots like you. **[**Will you give us the funds we need to win this landmark case and make the Left pay for what it did?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqcm3adnc8c0n6l4hr2mvjk871mt6sqlu78fb3vo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9ieeo36cph2bs)** We filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID-19 vaccine.And if we can win this critical lawsuit, we can put employers across the country on notice ahead of what some are calling a COVID resurgence.Dovid was the assistant concertmaster and first violinist, while Chris and Rachel both played the French Horn.They are some of the most talented musicians in the country in highly coveted and competitive positions._Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ When the Symphony introduced its vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions. Dovid, Chris and Rachel each hold sincere religious beliefs that prohibit them from taking the COVID vaccine.They all filed for religious exemptions and were willing to take other measures, like regularly testing, to prove they didn’t have COVID.But shortly after submitting their requestions for religious exemptions, the Symphony rejected their requests and put them on UNPAID LEAVE.These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish.**It doesn’t matter who you are or what you believe – the radical Left doesn’t respect your right to practice your faith as you see fit.** In their eyes, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them.I’m deciding to take a stand – and I hope you will too. **[**Please make a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for religious freedom and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd2s26nv2r29fssi5r1e7i3nc4s62gm7jun7ek3o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c9ieeo36cph2bs)** Even after lifting its vaccine mandate, the Symphony refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.I hope I can count on your support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
Harmeet K. Dhillon Founder & CEO

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
I’m running for U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other — to call the shots in our country.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
Before I ask you to add a donation to my campaign before our November fundraising deadline tomorrow, I wanted to take some time to share a little bit more about the community I grew up in and why I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.
**Will you please let me explain?**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39442?refcode=em20231129-4283&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4283%2E614464%2Ei6NoVu)
I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri — and like so many other American families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, we went bankrupt.
We got by thanks to the generosity of our neighbors and people around town. They took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, our neighbors brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
Eventually, their support helped me go to college. And after that I joined the Marines to honor everything our community did for me and my family growing up.
But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, our old neighborhood had been picked for parts — our local corner store was boarded up, our family’s first home in the neighborhood was bulldozed to the ground. **Now it’s an empty lot:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39442?refcode=em20231129-4283&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4283%2E614464%2Ei6NoVu)
While all of us were risking our lives to build up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and corporate elites like Josh Hawley let our towns and neighborhoods at home waste away. And then, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, they couldn’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into our own country.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate because it’s time everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other — called the shots in this country.[And today, I’m asking for your support to make it happen.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39442?refcode=em20231129-4283&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4283%2E614464%2Ei6NoVu)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39442?refcode=em20231129-4283&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4283%2E614464%2Ei6NoVu)
**If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve waged economic warfare on our country, I need you on this team.[Can you add a $10 donation right now so we’ll have the resources we need to get our message in front of voters and flip this U.S. Senate seat? I don’t take any money from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39442?refcode=em20231129-4283&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4283%2E614464%2Ei6NoVu)**

clean_body: I’m running for U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other — to call the shots in our country. Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce. Before I ask you to add a donation to my campaign before our November fundraising deadline tomorrow, I wanted to take some time to share a little bit more about the community I grew up in and why I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. Will you please let me explain? I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri — and like so many other American families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, we went bankrupt. We got by thanks to the generosity of our neighbors and people around town. They took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, our neighbors brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. Eventually, their support helped me go to college. And after that I joined the Marines to honor everything our community did for me and my family growing up. But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, our old neighborhood had been picked for parts — our local corner store was boarded up, our family’s first home in the neighborhood was bulldozed to the ground. Now it’s an empty lot: While all of us were risking our lives to build up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and corporate elites like Josh Hawley let our towns and neighborhoods at home waste away. And then, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, they couldn’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into our own country. I’m running for U.S. Senate because it’s time everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other — called the shots in this country. If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve waged economic warfare on our country, I need you on this team. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Thanks for having my back in this fight, Peter. clean_body: We have to be ready for anything the Left throws at us. | Peter, My team intercepted the email below that was sent out by the DCCC that outlines the 18 districts they are focusing their efforts on to try to gain the 5 seats they need to take back the House majority. It comes as no surprise that as a top battleground district of 2024, our name is on that list, and we have to be ready for whatever the Left may throw at us in the coming months. But after pausing our fundraising over the holiday weekend we have fallen behind on our monthly goal. If we fail to reach it by this week’s deadline then we won’t have the resources needed to fight back against these oncoming attacks to defend this all-important seat. That’s why I’m reaching out just a few days before the deadline to ask for your help. Last cycle, we were a top battleground seat and faced relentless attacks and saw MILLIONS poured into Arizona’s 6th District from the radical Left. With your help, we fought long and hard to secure this crucial victory for Republicans against all odds – winning by a very small margin. Now, with the House majority on the line once again and our race still considered a top battleground, the Left has doubled down on their attacks and efforts to get my Democrat opponent elected. We can’t afford to slow down or fall behind for even one second with a race this close. But I know with you by my side we can win this critical election once more and defend the Republican House majority to continue FIGHTING BACK against the Left’s disastrous agenda. Thank you, Rep. Junk fees, health care bills, rising prices
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/130?refcode=em20231129&t=1&akid=636%2E62735%2Ej-67nL)
Peter,
A few weeks ago, a mega-donor called Hill to offer $20 million in campaign contributions if he agreed to drop out and primary Rashida Tlaib.
**What he didn’t know is that Hill won’t be bossed, bullied, or bought.**
Hill said no — putting a target on his back. [**Chip in to help Hill fight back →**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231129?amount=5&refcode=em20231129-636&refcode2=636_62735_j-67nL&akid=636%2E62735%2Ej-67nL)
When POLITICO reported this story last week, it kind of blew up. We all know there’s too much big money in our politics, but a phone call like this makes it so obvious...
But Peter, really, special interests dominating our politics IS already obvious. You just have to look at a recent bank statement to see it for yourself.
It’s obvious in**junk fees**. The average American loses $1,000 annually to hidden or deceptive fees — adding up to billions in corporate profits — because our government listens to those company’s lobbyists instead of everyday consumers.
It’s obvious in **health care bills**. One third of all money raised on GoFundMe is for medical bills, because our current system is designed around Big Pharma greed and insurance company profits. As a result, getting sick can bankrupt you.
It’s obvious in **rising prices everywhere**. Corporations are shamelessly letting prices rise under the cover of “inflation” while their profits and executive bonuses hit all-time highs.
Life is getting more and more expensive because our government isn’t working for us. Our government isn’t working for us because _special interests and the wealthy donor class are dictating the agenda_.
Hill is running to uncorrupt our campaign finance system. Clearly, he can’t be bought. But after Hill refused $20 million to play the establishment’s game, we’ll need a powerful grassroots movement to take on the race ahead.
[**Our end-of-month deadline is in 1 day. Please, Peter, make your first donation now to help Hill take on big money and win this race the right way.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231129?amount=5&refcode=em20231129-636&refcode2=636_62735_j-67nL&akid=636%2E62735%2Ej-67nL)

Real change is ahead. Thank you for doing your part to support Hill!
-Hill Harper for Senate

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

clean_body: the cost of a dozen doughnuts | | | Friend, I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $150,000 end-of-month goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority. = = When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment. So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop. It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality. We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate. Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change.And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign next November. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you so much, Debbie Mucarsel-Powell | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. name: Ro Khanna
subject: Life-saving medication doesn’t work if you can’t afford it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

A recent report found that Pfizer is marketing Paxlovid, one of the few antiviral medications that works to treat COVID-19, for nearly $1400 for a single course [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/pfizer-covid-drug-paxlovid-price-rcna121469] . That’s more than 100 times what it costs to produce and more than double what it charged the U.S. government to distribute the medication free of charge during the pandemic.

Life-saving medication is a necessity, not a luxury. Those at the highest risk for COVID-related hospitalization, namely older and immunocompromised people, will soon be unable to get what they need to avoid a costly hospital stay.

Sign if you agree: We need to cap what Big Pharma charges for medication to ensure everyone who needs it can get it. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/cap-prescription-prices-petition?contactdata=jFNrTj5YwFFQ1nL4R4Z32/sxWa+T9SuH1ih90VS5C/ciGgH2vf6Zfsi9r58LsaIkh1oOi75P4BiwaKv/horL0m+dzQfQCPT9XFDpSI8CTr8kpRD780p3qtk5aHR7JFIgCQtHasAay93aKZ4L7GJeZw==]

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1715466187511918624?s=20 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1715466187511918624?s=20]

Americans pay more for their medications than any other country. Over 9 million Americans [https://www.cnn.com/2023/06/02/health/prescription-drug-costs-rationing/index.html#:~:text=Most%20adults%20between%20the%20ages,according%20to%20the%20CDC%20data.] tried to save money by skipping doses of their medications in 2021, while Big Pharma’s price gouging and lobbying efforts resulted in a staggering $38.7 billion [https://accountable.us/analysis-drug-companies-impacted-by-biden-rx-cost-saving-effort-boasted-of-38-7b-in-profits-in-2022/] in profits the following year.

No matter the condition, we have an obligation to ensure that all Americans can access the medications they need.

Tell Congress: Cap prescription prices. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/cap-prescription-prices-petition?contactdata=jFNrTj5YwFFQ1nL4R4Z32/sxWa+T9SuH1ih90VS5C/ciGgH2vf6Zfsi9r58LsaIkh1oOi75P4BiwaKv/horL0m+dzQfQCPT9XFDpSI8CTr8kpRD780p3qtk5aHR7JFIgCQtHasAay93aKZ4L7GJeZw==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/cap-prescription-prices-petition?contactdata=jFNrTj5YwFFQ1nL4R4Z32/sxWa+T9SuH1ih90VS5C/ciGgH2vf6Zfsi9r58LsaIkh1oOi75P4BiwaKv/horL0m+dzQfQCPT9XFDpSI8CTr8kpRD780p3qtk5aHR7JFIgCQtHasAay93aKZ4L7GJeZw==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Fellow American, This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also a GOP candidate in the MUST WIN race in NC, a district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.
---
[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f847bea23f204a9d93e62a064c494e8f&_e=pkg4YiJUOas48d80kxiJdzZyxUCEQNAjEsz8iwdLo5wIQ5tvzZn_GTuqK5BUD3ptL_qXTytLgGcndKFMs9_qOkulq0FmV8Na-Dv9caX9EZ0Au35hk54OB0NBynE2Y66Qe-2DANGvtSzoIPKE2oBKnjjDZhIhwv5KviE2J8N0mFAtoRJAK1OezmlbA5Rz3f6t64Ii41MyPjgAU_MGmEEAfOjlBMKz30-wswcuZdHTc6BIe38VW09nhBfLsO0MzE9r39mTqr-rtzNTpG-9GE11Hw6s7KuSIkg_PjlrUKdXaIUCg7jCIXJ7zIy133GgaZcSbUgW1X1AkNCqKEmuEI4zjMLnqwapxnw_Y7LabdsLri4%3D)

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can't win this race. But I bet you've heard that one before...

Peter, I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $150,000 end-of-month goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority. **[(If you're short on time and ready to retire Rick Scott next fall, you can split a donation between my campaign and United Rural Democrats to help me make up this fundraising gap and flip Florida blue.)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74254760/441054114/1984876690?refcode=urd-em-231129-split_mucarsel-powell&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU3MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmI0MWQ4YzUtZWM4ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzY2JhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RBf2oTScbCFkLB3D9cLGoNEt7kH4FnDk83uocAbVRxM=)** When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment. **So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality. We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.** **Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change. clean_body: | | Peter, I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $150,000 end-of-month goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority. = When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment. So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop. It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality. We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate. Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change. name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: let's keep the dream alive
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
I'm running so that everyone is equipped with the support they need to achieve their dreams. And unlike my opponent, I'm relying on the help of this grassroots community to win in Florida and keep the American Dream alive. |
#
Friend, this is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell from Florida. As an immigrant to America, I know firsthand how difficult it can be for working families to get by. But I've also seen the incredible opportunities that are only possible in America — **and now, I'm running for Senate to safeguard those opportunities that self-serving politicians like my opponent, Rick Scott, want to destroy.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74255143/441054970/-1890717080?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20231129_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2YzM2Q0Ny1lZDhlLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PPGU2Z-69eh_DSvKPyBfSa56FS73tcC_-vmfV9_mEKo=) **[If you're ready to pitch in and help this team reach our critical $150,000 end-of-November goal, you can click here to split a gift between my campaign and Tina Smith’s](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74255144/441054971/-1890717080?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20231129_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2YzM2Q0Ny1lZDhlLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PPGU2Z-69eh_DSvKPyBfSa56FS73tcC_-vmfV9_mEKo=) — but first, I hope you'll let me explain why I'm fighting to keep the American Dream alive.** | [CHIP IN NOW!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74255145/441054972/-1890717080?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20231129_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2YzM2Q0Ny1lZDhlLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PPGU2Z-69eh_DSvKPyBfSa56FS73tcC_-vmfV9_mEKo=)
---
My American Dream came true because my mother left our home in Ecuador and bravely brought my sisters and me to this country to give us a chance to build the future she dreamed of.
My American Dream came true because my mother worked day and night to afford rent in our one room apartment and provide us with a better education, a better home, and a better future.
My American Dream came true because I was able to go from working a minimum wage job to help my mom make ends meet to serving in Congress.
My American Dream came true because I had a strong community to lean on, opportunities to grow, and the right to live my life as I wanted.
**I'm fighting to protect those same opportunities, which are now out of reach for far too many working families.**
See, my opponent has made a career — _and nearly a quarter-billion dollars_ — off trampling vital programs, dividing communities, and threatening the opportunities upon which American Dreams like mine were built.

Hi Peter, Grady here -- finance director of Joanna Weiss’ campaign to keep CA-47 blue.

Tomorrow is our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and it is one of the last of the year. It is hard to believe that in just a few short weeks we will be gearing up for our primary election in March!

With so much on the line, here is where we stand:
* New polling shows that Joanna is the best candidate we have to keep CA-47 from falling into Republican hands. **She is up by 1 point against our GOP opponent Scott Baugh -- but when voters learn more about Joanna’s message, her lead jumps to 14 points.**

* Hundreds of new supporters have joined Team Joanna over the last few months. **In the last fundraising quarter, Joanna was ranked the #1 woman fundraiser nationwide in an open race, and the #2 fundraiser nationwide for a first-time candidate.**

**CONSERVATIVE LOCAL AND NATIONAL LEADERS** **ENDORSE GABE EVANS FOR CONGRESS** Conservative State Representative and Colorado Congressional District 8 candidate Gabe Evans today announced the endorsements of several new local and national leaders. "The momentum for our campaign is real. I hear it every day. Conservatives here in Colorado and across the nation are hungry for a next generation, can-do leader who can make a difference and shake up Washington. I'm eager to put my experience to work to be that agent of positive change." "Today, we're announcing the endorsement of several Colorado and national conservative leaders. I am truly honored by their endorsements and thankful for their support. These endorsements build on our existing endorsements, including **Brighton Mayor Greg Mills, Federal Heights Mayor Linda Montoya, Gilcrest Mayor Steve Nothem, State Representative Anthony Hartsook, former State Senator and Weld County Sheriff John Cooke, former House Speaker Frank McNulty, U.S. Senator Tom Cotton (R-Ark.), and Congressmen Jack Bergman (R-Mich.) and Brian Mast (R-Fla.)** ," said Gabe Evans. **
****Commerce City Councilman and Former Mayor Sean Ford** **
****Former Colorado Board of Education Member Peggy Propst** : "Gabe Evans is the can-do, next generation conservative voice Colorado needs in Congress to shake up Washington, D.C. He's also a leader on issues of great importance to me: promoting education reform and school choice, defending the home-school community, and getting political agendas like critical race theory (CRT) out of our schools. Join me in voting for Gabe Evans for Congress in 2024!" **Congressman Mario Diaz-Balart (R-Fla.)** : "Gabe Evans would be a breath of fresh air for the conservative cause in Congress. Gabe's unstoppable optimism and energy -- as evidenced by his life as a U.S. Army combat veteran, police officer, conservative state representative, and Hispanic family man -- are exactly what we need to shake up Washington, D.C. Please join me in supporting Gabe Evans for Congress!" Congressman John James (R-Mich.): "Gabe Evans has been on the front lines all his life -- as a Middle East combat veteran, as a police officer, and as a conservative state representative taking on liberals in the Colorado Legislature. Now, we need Gabe Evans on the front lines in Congress to bring conservative change in Washington, D.C. Please join me in supporting Gabe Evans for Congress!" **Congressman Tony Gonzales (R-Tex.)** : "As a veteran who represents hundreds of miles along America's Southern border who knows first-hand the consequences of Joe Biden's disastrous policies. I can't wait to have Gabe Evans' military and law enforcement experience in Congress to help secure the Southern border, shut down the cartels, and stem the flow of fentanyl and drugs in America.**I urge Coloradans to elect Gabe Evans for Congress**!"

I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=89004fb607914c8ca294a456a0940f2d&_e=SxojtCTcEWDtRUsQX0jUItDpvw9dgTIYh7tfqxsBlJFFIGp5WqHRkJim8Y29V-yvc_byrgrKOqKV-SiwrHaXWzUaNAUC5nN8Jfa4LG81Qf-9zTt3PAobi1bp_zPbKSAApeMJsU4_SxmhcooJ90RB98UtKurNfqdTx7TzNLs15dTopj8oqA95Ja32QQe6i11esvW0U5Ib2D8Mif_BXKU9uZW32V9ko8OXaMQ51ViSVNTzEt1sfy6BLk9LZdnn27Icid6CseIIOUMOsQtuT7Mynpb7CybZiqBdQKLo1KGc7b8qpndABFTBKqmw9jrXZW1dViExlmTdAuafWqNF8se7mbIY9s4WoaL4hZFfwjPAArSX0zrEY7jdPU1PUJUiIPqxfsAq71ilnqwWO2OKn4kvZB-WqRB0iK7pY5N_iKeMmVY%3D)**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=89004fb607914c8ca294a456a0940f2d&_e=SxojtCTcEWDtRUsQX0jUItDpvw9dgTIYh7tfqxsBlJFFIGp5WqHRkJim8Y29V-yvc_byrgrKOqKV-SiwrHaXWzUaNAUC5nN8Jfa4LG81Qf-9zTt3PAobi1bp_zPbKSAApeMJsU4_SxmhcooJ90RB98UtKurNfqdTx7TzNLs15dTopj8oqA95Ja32QQe6i11esvW0U5Ib2D8Mif_BXKU9uZW32V9ko8OXaMQ51ViSVNTzEt1sfy6BLk9LZdnn27IcEm0UbjpexIvzj2T2NWkjQMdECngtcPngjX13iOP-qk5S1dEjEtspxo1BohTHspSoCywJk-0Vxjq2Ne7KO11BjIovmOhAhUPmb2EVTnRCFH38cg84gmyNj532VhmkqhwpQ5V2130GbJPE7SOD4ScsdPvlLqo05GGhijN-OBrYyUE%3D)

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

---
| | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=89004fb607914c8ca294a456a0940f2d&_e=SxojtCTcEWDtRUsQX0jUItDpvw9dgTIYh7tfqxsBlJFFIGp5WqHRkJim8Y29V-yvc_byrgrKOqKV-SiwrHaXWzUaNAUC5nN8Jfa4LG81Qf-9zTt3PAobi1bp_zPbKSAApeMJsU4_SxmhcooJ90RB98UtKurNfqdTx7TzNLs15dTopj8oqA95Ja32QQe6i11esvW0U5Ib2D8Mif_BXKU9uZW32V9ko8OXaMQ51ViSVNTzEt1sfy6BLk9LZdnn27IcvCuSGrvhRtitOugdwg3gHc5B3_qkyE4-lKCcI09WuGHune98ACpJN6MOyt3USjXF0erK-xojoWfVhga2RE3p9mLqpfvUDhr5d-cBe9RdY33NVV6Pc3cHn9cY7zUhMojTsH2VPpEEO22QEqFRF_GNSlgM0Ci5GscCItBNOA9j5s8%3D)
---
When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. To send Dr. Bob into December stronger than ever, we need your help hitting a goal. Doc does so much for our communities, and we want to ensure that he's well-positioned in 2024 to compete against Rep. Jack Bergman.
That's where we can all pitch-in to end November strong and crush this fundraising quarter.

CONTRIBUTE $4 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/drboblorinser]

[https://gen.sendtric.com/countdown/e1k4zbgmh0]
Here's where we are on accomplishing our goals.
4,600 total donations this year
We want to hit 5,000 before Dec. 31.
1,984 unique donors this year
We want to hit 2,024 before 2024.
We'll get there! We're so close!
Our average donations is $30
CONTRIBUTE $20.24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/drboblorinser]
Friend,
Bob believes that raising exorbitant amounts of money for campaigns has a corrupting influence on our political system.
He is a fierce advocate for campaign finance reform because candidates who receive funding from giant corporate PACs, ultra-wealthy donors, or dark money may have windfalls, but they don't have people power, and that's not democracy.
Bob won't compromise his values to raise money.
To get to DC and influence reform — like overturning Citizens United — we need to double our efforts. And, there's great news. So far, we have raised over 215% more than we did at this stage last cycle.
Momentum is with us, and we need your continued support.
In 2022, considering redistricting, Bob Lorinser moved the needle for Democrats in rural Northern Michigan by five points. He raised more grassroots money than any Michigan Democrat facing an incumbent, and it was all powered by we the people.
Our fight endures.
Bob Lorinser believes in the people of his district, and we believe in him. He' s a workhorse. He loves campaigning. He loves connecting one-on-one with constituents and is committed to truly earning every vote.
We can do a lot on a shoestring budget and sweat — visit every one of our 35 counties, volunteer, attend community events, and go door-to-door — but your contribution helps us extend our reach to many more people.
Friend, we're so grateful to have you in our corner.
Thank you.
-Lorinser for Congress

Marquette, MI 49855

Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

We talk a lot about Jordan’s role in helping plan Donald Trump’s illegal attempt to stay in power after losing the 2020 election, and about how he failed the athletes at OSU he was supposed to mentor and protect. Right now, the odds are stacked against us, and I need to know how you 'll react to this email to understand how to move forward. Your response could change everything. My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress. I worked hard to serve my community alongside my wife, Amanda. And above all, I am a father to three amazing girls. Now, I am also a Senate candidate in a crucial race in Indiana. The outcome of this election will determine if we can take back the Senate. Joe Biden and his Leftist collaborators are pouring millions into key races across the country in an effort to wipe out GOP candidates. But I won't let them win so easily. The Democrats have planted a fake Republican in my race to stop me from winning. They don't realize that I've been in this community for years, and I know that Americans are fed up with the progressive narrative. I'm not usually the type of person to ask for help, but there's no way I can make it on my own. The Democrats are attacking us from ALL angles because they hate what we stand for: freedom and American pride. | Friend, I'm not an establishment politician who will play games with the American people. I am a Patriot who wants to save America for the next generation. That's why I'm being so candid with you today. I'm not going to make false promises and tell you I can fix our country overnight. But I can promise you that I will make it my mission to restore faith in our government and put the American people before political deals. I intend to make you proud. Friend,
Last week, I had an insightful conversation on my podcast with some of the wrestlers who survived terrifying abuse at Ohio State University. Some of the men were coached by my opponent, Jim Jordan, who did nothing to stop the abuse despite being in a position to do so.
This week I had a conversation with a police detective on my podcast who told the horrifying and tragic story about his daughter, who was kidnapped, raped, and murdered. During the conversation, I was angered to learn that Jim Jordan voted against the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA)—a bill that punishes the perpetrators of heinous crimes against women and provides stronger protections for victims of domestic violence.
We talk a lot about Jordan’s role in helping plan Donald Trump’s illegal attempt to stay in power after losing the 2020 election, and about how he failed the athletes at OSU he was supposed to mentor and protect.
But there is just so much about his record—like his consistent votes against women. He actually voted NO on the Violence Against Women Act! Who does that? A monster, that's who. It just goes to show how unfit he is to hold public office and how utterly despicable he is as a person. **_At his core, Jim Jordan only cares about one thing: himself. _** **
****__****Enough is enough.** We don’t have to accept having selfish, power-hungry people like Jordan in Congress. We can do so much better, and accomplish so much more, if we work together. **
****I am ready to lead and to defeat Jim Jordan this election.** But we need to keep up our grassroots fundraising pace—and that’s why I need you with me.
