| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

clean_body: Here’s what we know so far: = Peter, this is urgent, so Future Forum PAC said I could reach out. Another Republican just announced their campaign to unseat me, and we have to respond NOW. Here’s what we know so far: There are now not one, but two extremist Republicans running to unseat me. As we speak, national Republicans and special interests are rushing money to this new opponent to make me a one-term member of Congress. No matter how many extremists try to unseat me, the truth remains the same: I am the ONLY pro-choice, pro-fish, pro-jobs, and pro-freedom candidate in this race. Alaska needs that advocacy – so in this moment, I need YOU. _Two_ potential candidates for U.S. Senate have now come forward to claim that they were each offered _$20 million_ by a major AIPAC donor in recent days if they would run against Rep. Rashida Tlaib — the only Palestinian-American in Congress — in a Democratic primary.1 And we already know that AIPAC — funded by right-wing megadonors — is preparing to spend as much as _$100 million_ to unseat progressive champions in Congress including Reps. clean_body: We’ve taken on right-wing megadonors before and won — but with this unprecedented level of outside spending we’ll need to redouble our efforts in order to have the resources we need to fight back. | | | Peter — Two potential candidates for U.S. Senate have now come forward to claim that they were each offered $20 million by a major AIPAC donor in recent days if they would run against Rep. Rashida Tlaib — the only Palestinian-American in Congress — in a Democratic primary.1 And we already know that AIPAC — funded by right-wing megadonors — is preparing to spend as much as $100 million to unseat progressive champions in Congress including Reps. Summer Lee, Cori Bush, Ilhan Omar, and Jamaal Bowman.2 AIPAC and the billionaire right-wing donors who fund them are threatening to spend millions to unseat WFP champions in 2024 because they know they are unbought and unafraid. We need to do all we can to fight back — and that starts now. We’ve taken on right-wing megadonors before and won — but with this unprecedented level of outside spending we’ll need to redouble our efforts in order to have the resources we need to fight back. Taking money from Republican billionaire donors like Home Depot’s co-founder Bernie Marcus and then using it to challenge progressive champions in Democratic primary races is revolting, but it certainly isn’t new for AIPAC.3 In 2022, they spent nearly $30 million in an attempt to defeat progressives in Congress — while also propping up over 100 January 6 insurrectionist Republicans. In 2024, they plan to spend as much as three times that amount to decimate the ranks of progressives in Congress.4 We simply can’t stand by and let our democracy be bought — and the voices of our champions silenced. Help us send a message to AIPAC that our democracy is not for sale. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , CBS News Detroit, November 28, 2023. 2\. , The Daily Beast , November 15, 2023. 3\. , Haaretz , August 6, 2023. 4\. , The New Republic, July 27, 2022. Peter,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last month has been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last month – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past month,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=c53fc374da0d4ce188ac84e682cd815f&_e=29aLK2YH7bKgo9vyGJCTtVCktfxMrb8yEj13hjw-IG01eNebsaMkYdxrV8Gdo6KDMP6H8XegT0I39l4AscjhV02RGRchZgmoBVZIt2fLuJhwRYrem4jX1lcFv1EzPlE3eAzFr_BLJFocaQC-fyahsA9FEjCCijIFqBuLGqPrzS29o_9IRxVhA_8As0yKP-INAMWh9NHX-1KCpsUCXMUGt5l5EfkUeyuKpiCp2bPNLhsn_5fNtxMRVjGPutLoCGo9whwJCcXgci_1YgQCoLvWeb8emy_COjJcAisCD4Eev5FDjdWJ0HQOROiC2dWpaAnHJY-n0ZMfMFZjx-G8950zEmeSnC6FkszBRli9qiTvjIP2A9-wF3L8D1pEkN_E8hH8aH8BhK_GW-VNAQuv6eZeig%3D%3D) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as Speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=c53fc374da0d4ce188ac84e682cd815f&_e=29aLK2YH7bKgo9vyGJCTtVCktfxMrb8yEj13hjw-IG01eNebsaMkYdxrV8Gdo6KDMP6H8XegT0I39l4AscjhV02RGRchZgmoBVZIt2fLuJhwRYrem4jX1lcFv1EzPlE3eAzFr_BLJFocaQC-fyahsA9FEjCCijIFqBuLGqPrzS29o_9IRxVhA_8As0yKP-INAMWh9NHX-1KCpsUCXMUGt5l5EfkUeyuKpiCp2bPNLhsn_5fNtxMRVjGPutLoCGo91BDzfSG01c3eoBoB1_jzu9_pT5FN5oDc8Yi-ws3lVa35_9isdpBxrlykrQvm5cYct-WF5mcn5xrN0Zj2Ga5y8nS1by285opT6Ex7tKJYTUTk_-KMpcaRlYaWU2d-jaUsUBfsWVv7-cGMlUetNj1A0g%3D%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

[**My staff has told me that we’re just short of having raised $2 million online since I was elected Speaker last month. In fact, we have just another $500,000 to raise to hit that mark – and we need to do it before Saturday at 11:59 p.m.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=c53fc374da0d4ce188ac84e682cd815f&_e=29aLK2YH7bKgo9vyGJCTtVCktfxMrb8yEj13hjw-IG01eNebsaMkYdxrV8Gdo6KDMP6H8XegT0I39l4AscjhV02RGRchZgmoBVZIt2fLuJhwRYrem4jX1lcFv1EzPlE3eAzFr_BLJFocaQC-fyahsA9FEjCCijIFqBuLGqPrzS29o_9IRxVhA_8As0yKP-INAMWh9NHX-1KCpsUCXMUGt5l5EfkUeyuKpiCp2bPNLhsn_5fNtxMRVjGPutLoCGo9WrJ0xEq4pBH-TXKKmcyI_jZs_oYipm5EmSQzzUTfIa3_AJzEujumyjmn5bACz2ZA8cII9MIraKmqee5QoirWm3GYOr9Yg0bg7haA0X6HkMaxgkh_3kEEdQK3bhoZnAe2d19w4otoCKiGiKvYBsX0Nw%3D%3D)

#### [**How ranked choice voting upended the Boulder mayor's race**](https://mgcp03.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6567bb213a182d0dea0c36ba&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.axios.com%2Flocal%2Fdenver%2F2023%2F11%2F09%2Fboulder-mayor-race-ranked-choice-voting-election&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_6567b9fa3f42a44a28c7694d&l=en-US&s=aVYyypTCorrJ-QvSixPqgC1QK6g%3D)
---
In the recent Boulder city election, Bob Yates, a former Republican who became unaffiliated in May 2022, initially led in the mayoral race. However, the introduction of ranked choice voting shifted the results. Incumbent Mayor Aaron Brockett, a liberal Democrat, overtook Yates with a lead of 497 votes and is expected to win. This shift is attributed to the second-choice votes from Nicole Speer's supporters, who finished third. Speer was endorsed by the local Democratic Socialists of America chapter. This election demonstrated the significant impact of ranked choice voting, which pushed Boulder's municipal politics further to the left. Yates, known for his limits on development and growth, had previously won more votes in the 2015 and 2019 council elections than Brockett. Brockett acknowledged that ranked choice voting was a key factor in his likely victory, differentiating it from a plurality winner system.
---
#### **RCV Overview**
Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) leads to confusion, disenfranchisement, and unfairly benefits left-wing candidates. It uses examples from various elections in the U.S. to argue against RCV.RCV as a Means to Left-Wing Power\- Instances where RCV affected election outcomes are highlighted, such as in Boulder, Colorado, where it helped a center-left candidate win.\- RCV is accused of leading to chaos, as seen in New York City’s 2021 election.RCV's Implementation Issues\- Errors and confusion in RCV implementation are cited, with examples like the Oakland School Board and Alameda County elections.\- Utah’s pilot program is mentioned as an example of RCV not delivering promised benefits.Reports and Studies on RCV\- A University of Minnesota report is referenced, claiming RCV fails to meet its proponents' promises.\- The report notes no significant change in voter turnout or diversity in elected officials with RCV.Voter Confusion and Disenfranchisement\- Examples from Oakland and Arlington, Virginia illustrate voter confusion and potential disenfranchisement.\- Low voter turnout, particularly among minority groups, is highlighted in Alaska’s 2022 general election.Opposition to RCV\- The D.C. Democrat party's rejection of RCV over concerns of disenfranchising minority voters is mentioned.\- Legal challenges to RCV are noted, arguing that it violates constitutional rights.Transparency and Majority Issues\- RCV is criticized for reducing transparency and complicating recounts.\- The concept of “ballot exhaustion” can prevent a true majority win.Specific Election Cases\- The role of RCV in Alaska and Maine elections is discussed, with emphasis on how it can alter expected outcomes.\- Cases where RCV led to unexpected winners are highlighted, questioning its effectiveness in reflecting majority preference. Overall, the text argues that RCV complicates the voting process, undermines traditional majority rule, and often benefits specific political groups at the expense of voter clarity and fairness.

#### **PSA:**
#### **We submitted a formal complaint to APOC (Alaska Political Office Commission) concerning the actions of the Pro-RCV group in Alaska. While they have accused us of breaching various State Campaign Finance Laws, we assert that this group should also adhere to the same rules and regulations. Contrary to their portrayal, this organization is not grassroots and receives substantial funding from outside of Alaska. Our objective is to hold them responsible for their apparent hypocrisy and their attempts to intimidate and tarnish the image of Alaskans, their organizations, and families. Their efforts to suppress our movement against ranked choice voting should not go unnoticed, and they must answer for potentially breaking the same laws they accuse us of. It's concerning that these well-informed political activists, who have benefited from massive out-of-state donations for their ranked choice voting agenda and campaign finance law changes, manipulate the system to their advantage, expecting regular citizens to falter and then overwhelm them with financial and legal burdens. We trust that the State of Alaska will ensure that these laws are applied uniformly, calling this Pro-RCV group to account for any disregard of Alaskan laws and norms.**
#### **Please see the full 111 page complaint when it is made public by the news and APOC. All of this information is public information.**

name: Mike Rogers
subject: The proudest day of my life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rogers for Senate
body:
I’ve dedicated my life to serving my country — here’s what I want to do next.| | |
---
[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=6fa359a86a8e4645b19077d9d88ebd66&_e=NI10GOhb4lhwvvvJGQZjq7IkTA1y6ASukMVKnRzy9Cwt-rNA1RIEJxkKYalEj8ARc24Yf95Ly1EHBQPBBGTEWiSipQRX55xspKbBBPDfdiTqbU9iBvhURYwn8ZwORVq93rC2uD0GTrRx3JZ7NKyxqlE4OCnJDbo9LCGu5HAkr-354y3m5SF8NOC0YfwUH_9lcjwTufBt5fXYW75eyBw3wtjSlip6mbX_ot16Bm-9lgA7jgp7KqsusDhtRfvRDbaSeSm17GZ794gSxwXN4VOIwd1hpZMguF_7Tp3SA8OA8q86B9-_i_Znkb0IEXV1nDZUjfRF2cAPzTEzhfclAIc_amtJzzHXfM0FwxxvknVW7b1HPDsA2aUQqVgM_48YaHG5sz7Pasp3DMQwgyis-2yaoA%3D%3D)
---
Friend, That’s me on one of the proudest days of my life. Joining the Army, wearing my uniform, and swearing loyalty for my country as my parents proudly looked on. My dad served in the Army, as my grandfather did before him. I was proud to carry on my family’s legacy of service. After four years of serving, I retired my uniform (and my 80’s hairstyle), but my service to the country I love was only beginning.
---
[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=6fa359a86a8e4645b19077d9d88ebd66&_e=NI10GOhb4lhwvvvJGQZjq7IkTA1y6ASukMVKnRzy9Cwt-rNA1RIEJxkKYalEj8ARc24Yf95Ly1EHBQPBBGTEWiSipQRX55xspKbBBPDfdiTqbU9iBvhURYwn8ZwORVq93rC2uD0GTrRx3JZ7NKyxqlE4OCnJDbo9LCGu5HAkr-354y3m5SF8NOC0YfwUH_9lcjwTufBt5fXYW75eyBw3wtjSlip6mbX_ot16Bm-9lgA7jgp7KqsusDhtRfvRDbaSJFGbB0yTmyXo3T5zou09uo1lB7mNW3beHZHO_FdqHhFVqZVqI-RLRqdZ9RnZTveYXYLwBigAA8ifwdJjQz4WPsyB1tegt7YHiGGsqpSzwCAtFPF8LaPvhMoyXDEH_pRN3X0rTB2OLsJUI0jnOmpRwg%3D%3D)
---
After leaving the Army, I joined the FBI as a Special Agent. I took on Chicago’s worst mobsters and criminals to keep the streets safe. Serving my country has always been my passion. My parents taught me from a young age that giving back to one’s country is a high honor. But recently, it seems like Americans don’t have the sense of pride for our country that I did growing up. **[That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=6fa359a86a8e4645b19077d9d88ebd66&_e=NI10GOhb4lhwvvvJGQZjq7IkTA1y6ASukMVKnRzy9Cwt-rNA1RIEJxkKYalEj8ARc24Yf95Ly1EHBQPBBGTEWiSipQRX55xspKbBBPDfdiTqbU9iBvhURYwn8ZwORVq93rC2uD0GTrRx3JZ7NKyxqlE4OCnJDbo9LCGu5HAkr-354y3m5SF8NOC0YfwUH_9lcjwTufBt5fXYW75eyBw3wtjSlip6mbX_ot16Bm-9lgA7jgp7KqsusDhtRfvRDbaS3GERsaAJbJU5dtgkGWXZg1A2_Aoopqbuc-mvMTPXY7Gi3GDWi3ortiZthf3S5UBNWoEmr34rn4XzELUJz0jq_VlCbJL2gH9FooS0lpG6dy3AuQxeT17VY-fgkMOthz6-4SUmNSrWmAXhAms7or27wQ%3D%3D)** You deserve an America that you can be proud of, Friend: an America that inspires people to service, an America whose leaders work for the people, not the other way around, and an America that lives up to her role as leader of the free world. I’m running for the Senate to get America back on track. Friend, if you support my mission, **[any amount of money you can give will go a long way](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=6fa359a86a8e4645b19077d9d88ebd66&_e=NI10GOhb4lhwvvvJGQZjq7IkTA1y6ASukMVKnRzy9Cwt-rNA1RIEJxkKYalEj8ARc24Yf95Ly1EHBQPBBGTEWiSipQRX55xspKbBBPDfdiTqbU9iBvhURYwn8ZwORVq93rC2uD0GTrRx3JZ7NKyxqlE4OCnJDbo9LCGu5HAkr-354y3m5SF8NOC0YfwUH_9lcjwTufBt5fXYW75eyBw3wtjSlip6mbX_ot16Bm-9lgA7jgp7KqsusDhtRfvRDbaS0QoXdfK68jsYcDMP8aMHFKCNSAwffmCoA_4mmtdm27g2j0d4S8m2XaM4yTGv8qP8VZlr5Ehv_p_VcszpPEUhokC8OAMLWAOpHToBtp_e8bMN6S9icnDW1xLL8pvDLHel5GuVj-8Vxawck53PyaxU3g%3D%3D)** toward helping me fight for our country. I hope I can count on you. Sincerely,
---
[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=6fa359a86a8e4645b19077d9d88ebd66&_e=NI10GOhb4lhwvvvJGQZjq7IkTA1y6ASukMVKnRzy9Cwt-rNA1RIEJxkKYalEj8ARc24Yf95Ly1EHBQPBBGTEWiSipQRX55xspKbBBPDfdiTqbU9iBvhURYwn8ZwORVq93rC2uD0GTrRx3JZ7NKyxqlE4OCnJDbo9LCGu5HAkr-354y3m5SF8NOC0YfwUH_9lcjwTufBt5fXYW75eyBw3wtjSlip6mbX_ot16Bm-9lgA7jgp7KqsusDhtRfvRDbaSEG7Q7GHAvy5O8JGMObtxyKK9F_ZgbuYkdeuVM2k6lwaSRFB3XSdmUVXBqc3J6sTCPVWraW17hy9Mkqd6YeH1SxwtXrLM1T7wyDmxIxQHjHIqJ_td5aPlEF-1Gh9KueQBYYK_e5t0oc0GfdRciBKIew%3D%3D)

Peter,

House Republicans wanted us to believe that _finally_ electing a speaker would put an end to the Party's chaos. Now, as they prepare for a _third vote_ to expel Rep. George Santos over his latest wave of ethics scandals, Speaker Mike Johnson is conspicuously silent.

Despite spending less than a year in public office, Rep. George Santos' tenure has been defined by his lies and corruption. Santos now faces 23 criminal charges linked to misuse of campaign donations, wire fraud, and lying to Congress — among other glaring ethics violations.

Still, House Republican leadership remains _silent_ on whether they will vote to expel Santos.

The reality is that we know exactly what this silence means, Peter. The modern Republican Party is not only power hungry — it's morally bankrupt. The GOP will prioritize holding their narrow majority over holding one of their own accountable — _and Americans will pay the price_.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Peter,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last month has been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last month – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past month,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d416be2f22e74ae1b3da541fe3a03657&_e=D6nxDQHL2-J7qkRKwHUh9rv8EOOpRNarR-4yEpZbMRkBrMICkucopcLu0WJkWhLOYYfKY3acYYisPDHR25DfVKi1OTNDC5Kyq3Mnc0QHzR3bI6ip-96yespE_AR-3pXPnnyopuvx6VrU1lbEzKU7JW2jQUAP71ly3Hi-WR_iJ86bWSHma5kFnMvn5yhQxq-YG5YkrTtWy6pHEojN-jIoRxnm-sJWmnDMKspnVoBnJSPg-A10p2Y5axgN3jT2d5Mzif-XDWH_BUH3Oq5e6NQNI-k2zX06qDU9TaPpafF2N-CljDiIewxyp75aGUipJYkz7S5odOp4jQv14F1J0NiXKSIzF9x113ZanD28_COhj9OrtpfReKXyJL97Rytp0V8fgPbfmRP0two-M9WrJblpdQ%3D%3D) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as Speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d416be2f22e74ae1b3da541fe3a03657&_e=D6nxDQHL2-J7qkRKwHUh9rv8EOOpRNarR-4yEpZbMRkBrMICkucopcLu0WJkWhLOYYfKY3acYYisPDHR25DfVKi1OTNDC5Kyq3Mnc0QHzR3bI6ip-96yespE_AR-3pXPnnyopuvx6VrU1lbEzKU7JW2jQUAP71ly3Hi-WR_iJ86bWSHma5kFnMvn5yhQxq-YG5YkrTtWy6pHEojN-jIoRxnm-sJWmnDMKspnVoBnJSPg-A10p2Y5axgN3jT2d5Mz_WvqI1IiuK8oRW1BC0BBmOnTQMYT-MhtKlKml3bEvLBNy2Fd6NvMeqY_tGFczJf_s9auWiD3__YLsMeFkMrQx3rE4Mz3Yz6fIVr5-v7IF2FcdNaGqr3CCJ0_jL5K2CXBxofC9MGbeWxV_DoY3up-xA%3D%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others. 4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year. Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.

** Campaign News and Views
------------------------------------------------------------
https://twitter.com/RyanBinkley/status/1726768464717660373?mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Meet and Greet Season
------------------------------------------------------------
This week, Ryan is visiting with voters in Iowa at several meet-and-greets across the state. He'll appear at the Tennessee Young Republicans dinner in Nashville this Friday and end the week in our nation's capital with the Young Republicans of Washington DC.

https://www.unionleader.com/news/politics/voters/binkley-says-hes-the-only-2024-candidate-offering-comprehensive-agenda/article_d53c444b-f252-594e-b573-b52cc1209464.html?mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID

** New Hampshire
Union Leader Article
------------------------------------------------------------

The Union Leader wrote about Ryan's campaign plans and policies. Despite facing an uphill climb, Ryan remains committed and continues to share his vision with America.
Read here (https://www.unionleader.com/news/politics/voters/binkley-says-hes-the-only-2024-candidate-offering-comprehensive-agenda/article_d53c444b-f252-594e-b573-b52cc1209464.html?mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Pizza and Politics
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan enjoyed a slice of pizza at New England College's Pizza and Politics event. He spoke with students and answered their campaign questions.

https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=1685174515312152&mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID

** 1540 KXEL Interview
------------------------------------------------------------

KXEL radio in Dysart, Iowa interviewed Ryan last week. Ryan shared his plan to restore prosperity for all Americans. Watch here (https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=1685174515312152&mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

**
Coming Up

------------------------------------------------------------

** Events with the YR
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan will appear at two upcoming Young Republican events. First, he will speak at the after-party for the Tennessee YR Governor Winfield Dunn Dinner on December 1st. RSVP here. (https://secure.winred.com/tennessee-young-republicans/tickets?mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID) Then he'll travel to DC to speak at the YR First Christmas Party of the Season, on December 2nd. RSVP here. (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/dcyr-america-first-christmas-party-of-the-season-tickets-752921738187?mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Greene Meet and Greet
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan will host a meet and greet at Bett and Bev's BBQ, where he'll talk with the people of Iowa about his plans to unify the nation. The event starts at 12:45 pm on December 6th, at 808 Vine St, Jefferson, IA.
https://www.lectures.iastate.edu/lectures/presidential-candidate-event-conversation-ryan-binkley?mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Iowa State
Townhall Forum
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan will converse with students at an Iowa State forum on December 6th at 6:00 pm. The event will be held at 2623 Memorial Union.
Details here (https://www.lectures.iastate.edu/lectures/presidential-candidate-event-conversation-ryan-binkley?mc_cid=75db48a44f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

subject: Social Security Overpays Billions Under Leadership of Racial Equity Activist
body:
Under the leadership of a noted racial equity activist the Social
Security Administration (SSA) has mistakenly overpaid beneficiaries
tens of billions of dollars, including a 65% spike in overpayments in
one year.

[alt_text]

[*****]
November 29, 2023

[article-image]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65997&L=30776&F=T&&hash=d8b61def915d1082f62b89e903f7bca7bc77c03d36312b6bdf030e87d6012133]

Under the leadership of a noted racial equity activist the Social
Security Administration (SSA) has mistakenly overpaid beneficiaries
tens of billions of dollars, including a 65% spike in overpayments in
one year. In 2023 the agency with a stated mission of ensuring equity
and accessibility by addressing systemic barriers to participation and
a commitment to providing services to underserved communities made a
whopping $23 billion in overpayments, according to its latest Agency
Financial Report. The figure is a marked increase over the already
stunning $11.1 billion in overpayments that SSA erroneously made in
2022.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Not long ago
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Friend —
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a donation of $20 to Seth Moulton and my campaign ahead of the end-of-month deadline. But first, I hope you’ll give me a moment to update you on all that is going on.
Not that long ago, Republicans took the step of censuring me in the House.
Censuring a representative is an extraordinary step — one that’s only been reserved for a few dozen times in our nation’s two-century history.
Their reason? Political retribution for exposing Donald Trump’s Russia and Ukraine misconduct and for holding him accountable during his first impeachment trial.
Kevin McCarthy backed the censure resolution to appease Trump and his MAGA members in Congress. In fact, Trump threatened to primary any Republican who voted against the resolution. Many Republican members who opposed it, then folded like a tent, and when the time came, the measure passed by a party-line vote.
Unfortunately, it’s clear the GOP still sees me as their biggest threat — because the attacks haven’t stopped.
Just last week, Trump just attacked me in Iowa, now Sean Hannity and Kid Rock are piling on.
As you can see, these MAGA attacks are getting more and more desperate by the day, friend. They know how effective I am, so they are prepared to throw every dirty trick in the book to sabotage my campaign for truth and justice — especially as the election gets closer.
But like I said on the House floor when they censured me: I am honored to have earned their enmity. I am flattered by their falsehoods. And I will not yield. Not one inch.
I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, so it will take a movement of grassroots supporters to overcome Donald Trump and his allies’ attacks. Will you add in a split donation between Seth Moulton and my campaign of $20 or more before our end-of-month deadline tomorrow? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Thank you,
Adam
